keys: Welcome to the Heart of Candor, where Mana comes to die!
en: Welcome to the Heart of Candor, where Mana comes to die!
pt_BR: Bem-vindo ao Coração de Candor, onde Mana vem para morrer!

keys: This is the Heart of Candor. It is a cave system that has always contained high concentrations of Kaore.
en: This is the Heart of Candor. It is a cave system that has always contained high concentrations of Kaore.
pt_BR: Este é o Coração de Candor. É um sistema de cavernas que sempre conteve altas concentrações de Kaore.

keys: As Mana flows across Aemil, some of the energy decays and settles in particular areas.
en: As Mana flows across Aemil, some of the energy decays and settles in particular areas.
pt_BR: Quando Mana flui por Aemil, parte da energia decai e se acumula em áreas específicas.

keys: This is one of those areas. A place where Mana stops flowing and becomes Kaore.
en: This is one of those areas. A place where Mana stops flowing and becomes Kaore.
pt_BR: Esta é uma dessas áreas. Um lugar onde Mana para de fluir e se torna Kaore.

keys: The board where we are standing is a catalyst that uses the energy of this cave to summon all sorts of creatures.
en: The board where we are standing is a catalyst that uses the energy of this cave to summon all sorts of creatures.
pt_BR: A arena onde estamos é um catalisador que usa a energia desta caverna para invocar todo tipo de criatura.

keys: They will come in progressive waves and try to wear you down.
en: They will come in progressive waves and try to wear you down.
pt_BR: Elas virão em ondas crescentes e tentarão te desgastar.

keys: If you survive enough waves, the summoning will stop and you will have conquered the Heart of Candor.
en: If you survive enough waves, the summoning will stop and you will have conquered the Heart of Candor.
pt_BR: Se você sobreviver a ondas suficientes, a invocação para e você terá conquistado o Coração de Candor.

keys: I never thought about that... I don't know! I have always been here, I think?
en: I never thought about that... I don't know! I have always been here, I think?
pt_BR: Nunca pensei nisso... Não sei! Acho que sempre estive aqui?

keys: I am Gabz.
en: I am Gabz.
pt_BR: Eu sou Gabz.

keys: No one really knows. Some say its tunnels lead down to the core of Aemil and that it's all filled with Kaore.
en: No one really knows. Some say its tunnels lead down to the core of Aemil and that it's all filled with Kaore.
pt_BR: Ninguém sabe ao certo. Alguns dizem que seus túneis descem até o núcleo de Aemil e que tudo lá embaixo está cheio de Kaore.

keys: Others think that something about the rock attracts Kaore from all directions.
en: Others think that something about the rock attracts Kaore from all directions.
pt_BR: Outros acham que algo na rocha atrai Kaore de todas as direções.

keys: I don't ask myself too many questions.
en: I don't ask myself too many questions.
pt_BR: Eu não me faço muitas perguntas.

keys: Luckily for you, I hold the power of life and death in this place!
en: Luckily for you, I hold the power of life and death in this place!
pt_BR: Por sorte para você, eu tenho o poder da vida e da morte neste lugar!

keys: When you perish in this cave, I will use your Zielite Amulet to have your living essence restored at a Soul Menhir.
en: When you perish in this cave, I will use your Zielite Amulet to have your living essence restored at a Soul Menhir.
pt_BR: Quando você morrer nesta caverna, usarei seu Zielite Amulet para restaurar sua essência vital em um Soul Menhir.

keys: If I didn't save you, I'd quickly run out of pawns to play with.
en: If I didn't save you, I'd quickly run out of pawns to play with.
pt_BR: Se eu não te salvasse, ficaria logo sem peões para brincar.

keys: A high concentration of Mana could perhaps change the balance of energies.
en: A high concentration of Mana could perhaps change the balance of energies.
pt_BR: Uma alta concentração de Mana talvez pudesse mudar o equilíbrio das energias.

keys: But I am here to keep the Kaore at bay, so why not let me enjoy it?
en: But I am here to keep the Kaore at bay, so why not let me enjoy it?
pt_BR: Mas eu estou aqui para conter a Kaore, então por que não me deixar aproveitar?

keys: Kaore can turn creatures hostile and, over time, undead.
en: Kaore can turn creatures hostile and, over time, undead.
pt_BR: Kaore pode tornar criaturas hostis e, com o tempo, mortas-vivas.

keys: It powers them to act against living creatures and their connection to Mana.
en: It powers them to act against living creatures and their connection to Mana.
pt_BR: Ela as impulsiona a agir contra criaturas vivas e contra sua conexão com Mana.

keys: You might feel it too if you stay here too long.
en: You might feel it too if you stay here too long.
pt_BR: Você também pode sentir, se ficar aqui tempo demais.

keys: The fight has already begun. You can't start another one now.
en: The fight has already begun. You can't start another one now.
pt_BR: A luta já começou. Você não pode iniciar outra agora.

keys: You'll need to bring me 5 apples as a tribute before we begin.
en: You'll need to bring me 5 apples as a tribute before we begin.
pt_BR: Você precisará me trazer 5 maçãs como tributo antes de começarmos.

keys: You're not strong enough for this fight. Come back when you've reached level %d.
en: You're not strong enough for this fight. Come back when you've reached level %d.
pt_BR: Você não é forte o suficiente para esta luta. Volte quando atingir o nível %d.

keys: Would you like to change your hair style or color today?
en: Would you like to change your hair style or color today?
pt_BR: Gostaria de mudar o penteado ou a cor do cabelo hoje?

keys: You lower the bucket but it comes back up empty.
en: You lower the bucket but it comes back up empty.
pt_BR: Você desce o balde, mas ele volta vazio.

keys: This well has run dry.
en: This well has run dry.
pt_BR: Este poço secou.

keys: You would need a bottle to draw water from this well.
en: You would need a bottle to draw water from this well.
pt_BR: Você precisaria de uma garrafa para tirar água deste poço.

keys: You don't have any available space on your inventory.
en: You don't have any available space on your inventory.
pt_BR: Você não tem espaço livre no inventário.

keys: Hold still while your bottle is filling...
en: Hold still while your bottle is filling...
pt_BR: Fique parado enquanto sua garrafa enche...

keys: Your bottle is now filled with fresh water. You have another empty bottle.
en: Your bottle is now filled with fresh water. You have another empty bottle.
pt_BR: Sua garrafa está cheia de água fresca. Você tem outra garrafa vazia.

keys: Your bottle is now filled with fresh water.
en: Your bottle is now filled with fresh water.
pt_BR: Sua garrafa está cheia de água fresca.

keys: You want to keep sailing?
en: You want to keep sailing?
pt_BR: Quer continuar navegando?

keys: Take the helm on the upper deck. Me and the crew will handle the sails.
en: Take the helm on the upper deck. Me and the crew will handle the sails.
pt_BR: Assuma o leme no convés superior. Eu e a tripulação cuidamos das velas.

keys: You're too young to wander around here, finish school first then we'll talk.
en: You're too young to wander around here, finish school first then we'll talk.
pt_BR: Você é novo demais para ficar por aqui; termine a escola primeiro e então conversamos.

keys: What are you doing up here? The job's below deck. Move it!
en: What are you doing up here? The job's below deck. Move it!
pt_BR: O que está fazendo aqui em cima? O serviço é abaixo do convés. Andando!

keys: Aye? Make it quick, I'm busy.
en: Aye? Make it quick, I'm busy.
pt_BR: Sim? Seja rápido, estou ocupado.

keys: Something's been chewing through our stores in the hold. I bet it's again some Rattos... I need someone to deal with them.
en: Something's been chewing through our stores in the hold. I bet it's again some Rattos... I need someone to deal with them.
pt_BR: Algo está roendo nossas provisões no porão. Aposto que são Rattos de novo... preciso de alguém para cuidar deles.

keys: Here's the job.
en: Here's the job.
pt_BR: Aí está o serviço.

keys: Back again? Good. That hold hasn't cleaned itself.
en: Back again? Good. That hold hasn't cleaned itself.
pt_BR: De volta? Bom. O porão não vai se limpar sozinho.

keys: Rattos found something to sink their teeth into. Clear them out and you'll be paid for it.
en: Rattos found something to sink their teeth into. Clear them out and you'll be paid for it.
pt_BR: Os Rattos acharam algo para cravar os dentes. Limpe tudo e você será pago por isso.

keys: I found a new nest, there are more of them down there now, and bolder too. Pay's better this time.
en: I found a new nest, there are more of them down there now, and bolder too. Pay's better this time.
pt_BR: Achei um ninho novo, tem mais deles lá embaixo agora, e mais atrevidos também. O pagamento é melhor desta vez.

keys: Forget the rattos. We've got bats down there now. Bats, can you believe that?
en: Forget the rattos. We've got bats down there now. Bats, can you believe that?
pt_BR: Esqueça os rattos. Agora temos morcegos lá embaixo. Morcegos, pode acreditar?

keys: Close the door fast after you, the air there is quite nauseating.
en: Close the door fast after you, the air there is quite nauseating.
pt_BR: Feche a porta rápido depois de entrar; o ar de lá é bastante nauseante.

keys: You again? Good. Rattos don't know when to quit, they're back.
en: You again? Good. Rattos don't know when to quit, they're back.
pt_BR: Você de novo? Bom. Rattos não sabem desistir, eles voltaram.

keys: Same as always. Go down, clear them out, come up for your coin.
en: Same as always. Go down, clear them out, come up for your coin.
pt_BR: O mesmo de sempre. Desça, limpe tudo, suba para receber sua moeda.

keys: You again? Hold is quiet today, I won't need your help you can move on.
en: You again? Hold is quiet today, I won't need your help you can move on.
pt_BR: Você de novo? O porão está tranquilo hoje, não vou precisar da sua ajuda, pode seguir.

keys: Praise Splatyna, the mighty Slime Queen!
en: Praise Splatyna, the mighty Slime Queen!
pt_BR: Louvada seja Splatyna, a poderosa Rainha Slime!

keys: You, there! Do you come to offer gold to our viscous lady?
en: You, there! Do you come to offer gold to our viscous lady?
pt_BR: Você, aí! Vem oferecer ouro à nossa senhora viscosa?

keys: You still haven’t offered any riches to Splatyna?
en: You still haven’t offered any riches to Splatyna?
pt_BR: Você ainda não ofereceu riquezas a Splatyna?

keys: Go into her cave, find her followers, and give her the gold!
en: Go into her cave, find her followers, and give her the gold!
pt_BR: Entre na caverna dela, encontre seus seguidores e entregue o ouro a ela!

keys: The three loyal ones hold the keys, remember that!
en: The three loyal ones hold the keys, remember that!
pt_BR: Os três leais guardam as chaves, lembre-se disso!

keys: Wait... I heard something. A scream!
en: Wait... I heard something. A scream!
pt_BR: Espere... ouvi algo. Um grito!

keys: Did something happen to Splatyna?! What have you done?
en: Did something happen to Splatyna?! What have you done?
pt_BR: Aconteceu algo com Splatyna?! O que você fez?

keys: Good, good! I will be here making sure the Queen is happy.
en: Good, good! I will be here making sure the Queen is happy.
pt_BR: Bom, bom! Estarei aqui garantindo que a Rainha esteja satisfeita.

keys: Gone?! No, no! You’re lying! Splatyna can’t die!
en: Gone?! No, no! You’re lying! Splatyna can’t die!
pt_BR: Morreu?! Não, não! Você está mentindo! Splatyna não pode morrer!

keys: Just... go, before I lose my mind!
en: Just... go, before I lose my mind!
pt_BR: Apenas... vá embora, antes que eu perca a razão!

keys: Splatyna is not like the other slimes. She's powerful! She's been blessed by Kaore!
en: Splatyna is not like the other slimes. She's powerful! She's been blessed by Kaore!
pt_BR: Splatyna não é como as outras slimes. Ela é poderosa! Foi abençoada por Kaore!

keys: She was once a great queen. Her soul was banished and found its way here. Now she can be a great queen again!
en: She was once a great queen. Her soul was banished and found its way here. Now she can be a great queen again!
pt_BR: Ela foi uma grande rainha. Sua alma foi banida e encontrou o caminho até aqui. Agora ela pode ser uma grande rainha novamente!

keys: My queen loves gold. It makes her new form so pretty! She likes it better that way.
en: My queen loves gold. It makes her new form so pretty! She likes it better that way.
pt_BR: Minha rainha ama ouro. Deixa sua nova forma tão bonita! Ela prefere assim.

keys: We must give her the gold she demands. If we anger her, she will consume us all!
en: We must give her the gold she demands. If we anger her, she will consume us all!
pt_BR: Precisamos dar a ela o ouro que exige. Se a irritarmos, ela nos consumirá a todos!

keys: This is Splatyna's Golden Kingdom! It was once just a cave, but my queen now rules here.
en: This is Splatyna's Golden Kingdom! It was once just a cave, but my queen now rules here.
pt_BR: Este é o Reino Dourado de Splatyna! Antes era só uma caverna, mas minha rainha agora reina aqui.

keys: The slimes here are loyal to Splatyna. They guard her and her immense treasures.
en: The slimes here are loyal to Splatyna. They guard her and her immense treasures.
pt_BR: As slimes daqui são leais a Splatyna. Guardam a ela e seus imensos tesouros.

keys: Three of them are special, real loyal ones. They have the keys to her chamber, but they won't just hand them over. You'll have to earn them!
en: Three of them are special, real loyal ones. They have the keys to her chamber, but they won't just hand them over. You'll have to earn them!
pt_BR: Três delas são especiais, as verdadeiramente leais. Têm as chaves da câmara dela, mas não vão simplesmente entregá-las. Você terá que conquistá-las!

keys: But don't worry. If you bring enough gold, maybe Splatyna will let you through...
en: But don't worry. If you bring enough gold, maybe Splatyna will let you through...
pt_BR: Mas não se preocupe. Se trouxer ouro suficiente, talvez Splatyna o deixe passar...

keys: Very well, take this gold and offer it to Splatyna. She will judge your worth.
en: Very well, take this gold and offer it to Splatyna. She will judge your worth.
pt_BR: Muito bem, pegue este ouro e ofereça a Splatyna. Ela julgará o seu valor.

keys: You notice three different key locks, what would you like to do?
en: You notice three different key locks, what would you like to do?
pt_BR: Você percebe três fechaduras de chaves diferentes. O que gostaria de fazer?

keys: Clue 1
en: Clue 1
pt_BR: Pista 1

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 1.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 1.
pt_BR: Você encontra uma chave escondida sob a pista 1.

keys: Clue 2
en: Clue 2
pt_BR: Pista 2

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 2.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 2.
pt_BR: Você encontra uma chave escondida sob a pista 2.

keys: Clue 3
en: Clue 3
pt_BR: Pista 3

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 3.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 3.
pt_BR: Você encontra uma chave escondida sob a pista 3.

keys: Clue 4
en: Clue 4
pt_BR: Pista 4

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 4.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 4.
pt_BR: Você encontra uma chave escondida sob a pista 4.

keys: Clue 5
en: Clue 5
pt_BR: Pista 5

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 5.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 5.
pt_BR: Você encontra uma chave escondida sob a pista 5.

keys: My water is all gone! I don't know how I will get back to Tulimshar now.
en: My water is all gone! I don't know how I will get back to Tulimshar now.
pt_BR: Minha água acabou! Não sei como vou voltar para Tulimshar agora.

keys: A few days ago I decided to confront the desert and explore this area.
en: A few days ago I decided to confront the desert and explore this area.
pt_BR: Há alguns dias decidi encarar o deserto e explorar esta área.

keys: The cave here has an underground pond of very fresh and pure water.
en: The cave here has an underground pond of very fresh and pure water.
pt_BR: A caverna aqui tem um lago subterrâneo de água muito fresca e pura.

keys: People used to come here to collect water, but a few years ago the place became infested with snakes.
en: People used to come here to collect water, but a few years ago the place became infested with snakes.
pt_BR: As pessoas costumavam vir buscar água, mas há alguns anos o lugar foi infestado de cobras.

keys: I thought I could fight the snakes back, but I did not expect to find this many!
en: I thought I could fight the snakes back, but I did not expect to find this many!
pt_BR: Achei que conseguiria conter as cobras, mas não esperava encontrar tantas!

keys: I tried to reach the pond but the snakes keep attacking and I spill all the water that I collect.
en: I tried to reach the pond but the snakes keep attacking and I spill all the water that I collect.
pt_BR: Tentei chegar ao lago, mas as cobras não param de atacar e eu derramo toda a água que consigo.

keys: Do you think you could give it a try? I am so tired. I will need at least one full jug to journey back to the city.
en: Do you think you could give it a try? I am so tired. I will need at least one full jug to journey back to the city.
pt_BR: Você acha que poderia tentar? Estou tão cansado. Vou precisar de pelo menos um jarro cheio para voltar à cidade.

keys: These are not venomous snakes, but they are aggressive and there are so many...
en: These are not venomous snakes, but they are aggressive and there are so many...
pt_BR: Não são cobras venenosas, mas são agressivas e são muitas...

keys: The pond is deep inside the cave. The best way to find it is to get lost, you'll see it eventually.
en: The pond is deep inside the cave. The best way to find it is to get lost, you'll see it eventually.
pt_BR: O lago fica no fundo da caverna. O melhor jeito de encontrá-lo é se perder; você acaba encontrando.

keys: Fill my jug if you find it and bring it back here.
en: Fill my jug if you find it and bring it back here.
pt_BR: Encha meu jarro se o encontrar e traga de volta aqui.

keys: But watch out, you will lose some water along the way if one of those snakes bites you!
en: But watch out, you will lose some water along the way if one of those snakes bites you!
pt_BR: Mas cuidado, você perderá um pouco de água no caminho se uma daquelas cobras te morder!

keys: You made it! And with the water!
en: You made it! And with the water!
pt_BR: Você conseguiu! E com a água!

keys: Here, take this. It's all I have left.
en: Here, take this. It's all I have left.
pt_BR: Tome, pegue isto. É tudo o que me restou.

keys: I will go back to Tulimshar now, this area is way too dangerous.
en: I will go back to Tulimshar now, this area is way too dangerous.
pt_BR: Vou voltar para Tulimshar agora; esta área é perigosa demais.

keys: We will keep relying on the much safer wells inside the city. I guess this water belongs to the snakes now.
en: We will keep relying on the much safer wells inside the city. I guess this water belongs to the snakes now.
pt_BR: Continuaremos dependendo dos poços muito mais seguros dentro da cidade. Imagino que esta água agora pertence às cobras.

keys: Thank you for getting me that water. Maybe now I can relax a bit and take my time on the way back.
en: Thank you for getting me that water. Maybe now I can relax a bit and take my time on the way back.
pt_BR: Obrigado por conseguir aquela água para mim. Talvez agora eu possa relaxar um pouco e voltar com calma.

keys: These days in the desert were my happiest but I think it's time for me to go back to civilization now.
en: These days in the desert were my happiest but I think it's time for me to go back to civilization now.
pt_BR: Estes dias no deserto foram os mais felizes, mas acho que é hora de voltar à civilização.

keys: I understand. Come back if you change your mind.
en: I understand. Come back if you change your mind.
pt_BR: Entendo. Volte se mudar de ideia.

keys: Here is the jug. The water source is deep inside the cave.
en: Here is the jug. The water source is deep inside the cave.
pt_BR: Aqui está o jarro. A fonte de água fica no fundo da caverna.

keys: Here is an important tip for you: to find it, I remember I first went north then east...
en: Here is an important tip for you: to find it, I remember I first went north then east...
pt_BR: Uma dica importante: para achá-la, lembro que primeiro fui para o norte e depois para o leste...

keys: Then south? Or maybe I went further to the east then north again...
en: Then south? Or maybe I went further to the east then north again...
pt_BR: Depois para o sul? Ou talvez eu tenha ido mais para o leste e depois norte de novo...

keys: Truth be told, all I remember are the snakes and their sharp bites. Thankfully this kind doesn't have venom.
en: Truth be told, all I remember are the snakes and their sharp bites. Thankfully this kind doesn't have venom.
pt_BR: Sinceramente, tudo o que lembro são as cobras e suas mordidas. Por sorte esse tipo não tem veneno.

keys: Good luck out there, I'd still recommend for you to not go there all alone.
en: Good luck out there, I'd still recommend for you to not go there all alone.
pt_BR: Boa sorte lá fora, mas ainda recomendo que você não vá sozinho.

keys: If you could find someone else to help, I'm sure it would be easier to fight back the snakes and collect more water.
en: If you could find someone else to help, I'm sure it would be easier to fight back the snakes and collect more water.
pt_BR: Se conseguir mais alguém para ajudar, tenho certeza de que será mais fácil conter as cobras e juntar mais água.

keys: For generations my tribe has been crafting special clothes out of different materials.
en: For generations my tribe has been crafting special clothes out of different materials.
pt_BR: Há gerações minha tribo cria roupas especiais com materiais diferentes.

keys: Maybe if you bring me the right ones I could make something for you.
en: Maybe if you bring me the right ones I could make something for you.
pt_BR: Talvez, se você me trouxer os certos, eu possa fazer algo para você.

keys: I don't have all my tools here, let me think... Does a pair of jean chaps interest you?
en: I don't have all my tools here, let me think... Does a pair of jean chaps interest you?
pt_BR: Não tenho todas as minhas ferramentas aqui, deixa eu pensar... Você tem interesse em um Jean Chaps?

keys: For that I would need a regular Jeans Shorts and about 10 Snake Skins as those tends to tear when we manipulate them.
en: For that I would need a regular Jeans Shorts and about 10 Snake Skins as those tends to tear when we manipulate them.
pt_BR: Para isso precisaria de um Jeans Shorts comum e cerca de 10 Snake Skins, pois elas rasgam fácil quando manipuladas.

keys: Do we have a deal?
en: Do we have a deal?
pt_BR: Temos um acordo?

keys: Oh dear, it seems you don't have any jeans shorts.
en: Oh dear, it seems you don't have any jeans shorts.
pt_BR: Oh não, parece que você não tem nenhum Jeans Shorts.

keys: Oh dear, it seems you don't have enough snake skins.
en: Oh dear, it seems you don't have enough snake skins.
pt_BR: Oh não, parece que você não tem Snake Skins suficientes.

keys: Here you are!
en: Here you are!
pt_BR: Aqui está!

keys: Come back any time.
en: Come back any time.
pt_BR: Volte quando quiser.

keys: We are living in the desert cliff, west from here. The road is not open to outsiders.
en: We are living in the desert cliff, west from here. The road is not open to outsiders.
pt_BR: Moramos nas escarpas do deserto, a oeste daqui. O caminho não está aberto a forasteiros.

keys: I come out here to trade. That is as far as most strangers get.
en: I come out here to trade. That is as far as most strangers get.
pt_BR: Saio até aqui para comerciar. É até onde a maioria dos estranhos chega.

keys: The kingdom pulled out of this land a long time ago. Said it was not worth keeping.
en: The kingdom pulled out of this land a long time ago. Said it was not worth keeping.
pt_BR: O reino abandonou estas terras há muito tempo. Disseram que não valia a pena mantê-las.

keys: My people were here before them and we are still here today. We trade with Tulimshar when we need to but otherwise we prefer to keep our distances.
en: My people were here before them and we are still here today. We trade with Tulimshar when we need to but otherwise we prefer to keep our distances.
pt_BR: Meu povo estava aqui antes deles e ainda estamos aqui hoje. Comerciamos com Tulimshar quando precisamos, mas de resto preferimos manter distância.

keys: Alright, but you won't get a better deal anywhere else!
en: Alright, but you won't get a better deal anywhere else!
pt_BR: Está bem, mas você não vai conseguir acordo melhor em lugar nenhum!

keys: You dip the jug into the pond. Hold still for a few seconds while it fills...
en: You dip the jug into the pond. Hold still for a few seconds while it fills...
pt_BR: Você mergulha o jarro no lago. Fique parado por alguns segundos enquanto ele enche...

keys: This water is filthy! You do not think this is the pond Mauro had in mind.
en: This water is filthy! You do not think this is the pond Mauro had in mind.
pt_BR: Esta água está imunda! Você não acha que este seja o lago que Mauro tinha em mente.

keys: Welcome to Manayir.
en: Welcome to Manayir.
pt_BR: Bem-vindo a Manayir.

keys: We are Kahwe. An order of druids gathered to research, teach and protect the order of Mana in our world.
en: We are Kahwe. An order of druids gathered to research, teach and protect the order of Mana in our world.
pt_BR: Somos os Kahwe. Uma ordem de druidas reunida para pesquisar, ensinar e proteger a ordem de Mana em nosso mundo.

keys: Long ago we were spread across the region, each of us tending to Hantus that grew nearby. That time is behind us now.
en: Long ago we were spread across the region, each of us tending to Hantus that grew nearby. That time is behind us now.
pt_BR: Há muito tempo estávamos espalhados pela região, cada um cuidando dos Hantus que cresciam por perto. Essa época ficou para trás.

keys: We also had a presence in Tulimshar for a long time. Tried to keep Mana from being made into a matter of politics. That time is also behind us.
en: We also had a presence in Tulimshar for a long time. Tried to keep Mana from being made into a matter of politics. That time is also behind us.
pt_BR: Também tivemos presença em Tulimshar por muito tempo. Tentamos impedir que Mana se tornasse assunto de política. Essa época também ficou para trás.

keys: Now we preserve what we still know and continue our studies.
en: Now we preserve what we still know and continue our studies.
pt_BR: Agora preservamos o que ainda sabemos e continuamos nossos estudos.

keys: The Hantu, or Mana trees as they are also known, were the pillars of Mana in our world.
en: The Hantu, or Mana trees as they are also known, were the pillars of Mana in our world.
pt_BR: Os Hantu, também conhecidos como árvores de Mana, eram os pilares de Mana em nosso mundo.

keys: They connected all living things through the flow of Mana. Each one kept the land around it alive and prevented Mana from decaying into Kaore.
en: They connected all living things through the flow of Mana. Each one kept the land around it alive and prevented Mana from decaying into Kaore.
pt_BR: Eles conectavam todos os seres vivos através do fluxo de Mana. Cada um mantinha viva a terra ao seu redor e impedia que Mana decaísse em Kaore.

keys: When people came to fear Mana, they cut them down. It spread fast. Some religious and politics gave it a doctrine and a purpose, and before long there were none left.
en: When people came to fear Mana, they cut them down. It spread fast. Some religious and politics gave it a doctrine and a purpose, and before long there were none left.
pt_BR: Quando as pessoas passaram a temer Mana, começaram a cortá-los. O medo se espalhou rápido. Religiões e políticos lhe deram uma doutrina e um propósito, e em pouco tempo não restou nenhum.

keys: We were their guardians. We failed at that.
en: We were their guardians. We failed at that.
pt_BR: Éramos seus guardiões. Falhamos nisso.

keys: What remains of our purpose is keeping the knowledge of what they were. We study the flows and traces of Mana they left behind. We wait.
en: What remains of our purpose is keeping the knowledge of what they were. We study the flows and traces of Mana they left behind. We wait.
pt_BR: O que resta do nosso propósito é guardar o conhecimento do que eles foram. Estudamos os fluxos e rastros de Mana que deixaram. Nós aguardamos.

keys: You carry something.
en: You carry something.
pt_BR: Você carrega algo.

keys: A Kano, a Mana Seed.
en: A Kano, a Mana Seed.
pt_BR: Um Kano, uma Semente de Mana.

keys: I have only read about these, we all have. I never thought we would see one again.
en: I have only read about these, we all have. I never thought we would see one again.
pt_BR: Só tinha lido sobre eles, todos nós tínhamos. Nunca pensei que veríamos um novamente.

keys: Good, she knew it was the right choice.
en: Good, she knew it was the right choice.
pt_BR: Bom, ela sabia que era a escolha certa.

keys: But before everything I should tell you something.
en: But before everything I should tell you something.
pt_BR: Mas antes de tudo, devo te contar algo.

keys: The road ends here, for now.
en: The road ends here, for now.
pt_BR: A estrada termina aqui, por enquanto.

keys: The people who built this world are still working on what comes next. You have caught up to them.
en: The people who built this world are still working on what comes next. You have caught up to them.
pt_BR: As pessoas que construíram este mundo ainda estão trabalhando no que vem a seguir. Você as alcançou.

keys: Congratulation for getting this far and thank you for being part of this journey with us!
en: Congratulation for getting this far and thank you for being part of this journey with us!
pt_BR: Parabéns por chegar até aqui e obrigado por fazer parte desta jornada conosco!

keys: Stay as long as you like and please do come visit us and come say hi on our Discord.
en: Stay as long as you like and please do come visit us and come say hi on our Discord.
pt_BR: Fique o quanto quiser, e visite-nos: dê um oi no nosso Discord.

keys: Until then, Manayir and the Tonori region is yours to continue to explore.
en: Until then, Manayir and the Tonori region is yours to continue to explore.
pt_BR: Até lá, Manayir e a região de Tonori são seus para continuar explorando.

keys: You're the one Ekinu is sending down there?
en: You're the one Ekinu is sending down there?
pt_BR: Você é quem o Ekinu está mandando lá para baixo?

keys: I won't lie to you, he probably thinks you won't make it back...
en: I won't lie to you, he probably thinks you won't make it back...
pt_BR: Não vou mentir para você: ele provavelmente acha que você não volta...

keys: Head south-east of here. The entrance to the mine will be next to an old well.
en: Head south-east of here. The entrance to the mine will be next to an old well.
pt_BR: Siga para o sudeste daqui. A entrada da mina fica ao lado de um poço velho.

keys: If you find yourself crossing outside of this valley, you'll know it's the wrong direction.
en: If you find yourself crossing outside of this valley, you'll know it's the wrong direction.
pt_BR: Se você se pegar saindo deste vale, saberá que está na direção errada.

keys: Look for Watchman Nathan, he should be the one stationed at the mine's entrance.
en: Look for Watchman Nathan, he should be the one stationed at the mine's entrance.
pt_BR: Procure o Vigia Nathan; deve ser ele quem está de posto na entrada da mina.

keys: Good luck.
en: Good luck.
pt_BR: Boa sorte.

keys: I don't feel the same dark presence that I felt with the first one who came through here. Please come forward.
en: I don't feel the same dark presence that I felt with the first one who came through here. Please come forward.
pt_BR: Não sinto a mesma presença sombria que senti com o primeiro que passou por aqui. Por favor, pode se aproximar.

keys: For the first time in thousands of years, I will be needing someone's help.
en: For the first time in thousands of years, I will be needing someone's help.
pt_BR: Pela primeira vez em milhares de anos, vou precisar da ajuda de alguém.

keys: If you follow the western pass right there you'll leave Tulimshar Valley and venture into the Zuni Mesas.
en: If you follow the western pass right there you'll leave Tulimshar Valley and venture into the Zuni Mesas.
pt_BR: Se você seguir a passagem oeste ali, deixará o Vale de Tulimshar e entrará nas Mesas Zuni.

keys: Do you know where you're going?
en: Do you know where you're going?
pt_BR: Você sabe para onde está indo?

keys: If you follow this road you will be walking further away from the Sandstorm Mines.
en: If you follow this road you will be walking further away from the Sandstorm Mines.
pt_BR: Se seguir esta estrada, estará caminhando cada vez mais longe das Minas da Tempestade.

keys: You should head back west and aim for the southern side of this valley.
en: You should head back west and aim for the southern side of this valley.
pt_BR: Você deveria voltar para oeste e mirar o lado sul deste vale.

keys: You can follow that path to the north up to the city wall.
en: You can follow that path to the north up to the city wall.
pt_BR: Você pode seguir aquele caminho para o norte até a muralha da cidade.

keys: You can't miss it, the city wall is almost visible from there!
en: You can't miss it, the city wall is almost visible from there!
pt_BR: É impossível não ver; a muralha da cidade quase dá para avistar daqui!

keys: Go forward. I will keep you safe.
en: Go forward. I will keep you safe.
pt_BR: Siga em frente. Eu cuidarei da sua segurança.

keys: Thank you.
en: Thank you.
pt_BR: Obrigado.

keys: I could have defended myself just as I defended you, but he would have left, as he just did.
en: I could have defended myself just as I defended you, but he would have left, as he just did.
pt_BR: Eu poderia ter me defendido tão bem quanto defendi você, mas ele teria ido embora, como acabou de fazer.

keys: My location is known now and I need an ally against this new threat.
en: My location is known now and I need an ally against this new threat.
pt_BR: Minha localização agora é conhecida, e preciso de um aliado contra esta nova ameaça.

keys: Yes. I am an Uru, or a Mana Tree.
en: Yes. I am an Uru, or a Mana Tree.
pt_BR: Sim. Eu sou um Uru, ou uma Árvore de Mana.

keys: My kind was the first life on our world of Aemil and, until today, I thought I would be the last.
en: My kind was the first life on our world of Aemil and, until today, I thought I would be the last.
pt_BR: Meu povo foi a primeira vida em nosso mundo de Aemil e, até hoje, eu achava que seria o último.

keys: The person you just fought was after my Kano. You would call it a Mana Seed.
en: The person you just fought was after my Kano. You would call it a Mana Seed.
pt_BR: A pessoa com quem você acabou de lutar estava atrás do meu Kano. Vocês chamam de Semente de Mana.

keys: It is an exceptionally rare thing, as it can sprout into a new Uru. It is particularly precious at this time in our history, as I am the last Uru that is left alive.
en: It is an exceptionally rare thing, as it can sprout into a new Uru. It is particularly precious at this time in our history, as I am the last Uru that is left alive.
pt_BR: É uma coisa excepcionalmente rara, pois pode brotar em um novo Uru. É particularmente precioso neste momento da nossa história, já que sou o último Uru vivo.

keys: Although I would like to see it, I do not need the Sun's light to live.
en: Although I would like to see it, I do not need the Sun's light to live.
pt_BR: Embora eu gostaria de vê-la, não preciso da luz do Sol para viver.

keys: My roots extend deep into the earth and share in the source of life that empowers all of us: Mana.
en: My roots extend deep into the earth and share in the source of life that empowers all of us: Mana.
pt_BR: Minhas raízes se estendem fundo na terra e participam da fonte de vida que nos fortalece a todos: Mana.

keys: As long as I can connect to its flow, I am alive.
en: As long as I can connect to its flow, I am alive.
pt_BR: Enquanto eu conseguir me conectar ao fluxo, estou vivo.

keys: Many years ago this world was full of Uru like me. Our roots were interconnected and Mana flowed more powerfully than it does now.
en: Many years ago this world was full of Uru like me. Our roots were interconnected and Mana flowed more powerfully than it does now.
pt_BR: Há muitos anos este mundo era cheio de Uru como eu. Nossas raízes eram interligadas e Mana fluía com mais força do que hoje.

keys: Mana can behave in unexpected ways.
en: Mana can behave in unexpected ways.
pt_BR: Mana pode se comportar de formas inesperadas.

keys: When it disrupted the lives of people for a time, a belief that it could be harmful developed.
en: When it disrupted the lives of people for a time, a belief that it could be harmful developed.
pt_BR: Quando ela atrapalhou a vida das pessoas por um tempo, surgiu a crença de que poderia ser prejudicial.

keys: This quickly spread to many cultures and it became customary to cut down the Uru to limit the flow of Mana.
en: This quickly spread to many cultures and it became customary to cut down the Uru to limit the flow of Mana.
pt_BR: Isso logo se espalhou por muitas culturas, e tornou-se costume cortar os Uru para limitar o fluxo de Mana.

keys: When the Uru were threatened, a group of druids that intended to protect us planted a Kano here in this cave.
en: When the Uru were threatened, a group of druids that intended to protect us planted a Kano here in this cave.
pt_BR: Quando os Uru foram ameaçados, um grupo de druidas que queria nos proteger plantou um Kano aqui, nesta caverna.

keys: Then, they founded an order called Manayir somewhere nearby, to study and use the flow of Mana close to my roots.
en: Then, they founded an order called Manayir somewhere nearby, to study and use the flow of Mana close to my roots.
pt_BR: Então fundaram uma ordem chamada Manayir em algum lugar por aqui, para estudar e usar o fluxo de Mana perto das minhas raízes.

keys: I was born here, hidden from the world. Over time the Manayir let their knowledge of my existence fade, even from their own, so that I would remain hidden.
en: I was born here, hidden from the world. Over time the Manayir let their knowledge of my existence fade, even from their own, so that I would remain hidden.
pt_BR: Nasci aqui, escondido do mundo. Com o tempo, os Manayir deixaram o conhecimento da minha existência se perder, até dos seus próprios, para que eu continuasse oculto.

keys: I would ask you to never speak to anyone of my existence.
en: I would ask you to never speak to anyone of my existence.
pt_BR: Pediria que você jamais falasse a ninguém sobre a minha existência.

keys: Take the Kano, the Mana Seed.
en: Take the Kano, the Mana Seed.
pt_BR: Pegue o Kano, a Semente de Mana.

keys: The druid Nina of Tulimshar is someone I know you can trust with it. She is very attuned to the flow of Mana and I have come to know her presence.
en: The druid Nina of Tulimshar is someone I know you can trust with it. She is very attuned to the flow of Mana and I have come to know her presence.
pt_BR: A druida Nina de Tulimshar é alguém com quem sei que você pode contar. Ela é muito sintonizada com o fluxo de Mana, e passei a conhecer a presença dela.

keys: You should tell the guards inspecting the mines around here that you found great dangers and that it is not safe to access the lower levels.
en: You should tell the guards inspecting the mines around here that you found great dangers and that it is not safe to access the lower levels.
pt_BR: Diga aos guardas que inspecionam as minas por aqui que você encontrou grandes perigos e que não é seguro acessar os níveis inferiores.

keys: I have no choice but to trust that you will take good decisions.
en: I have no choice but to trust that you will take good decisions.
pt_BR: Não tenho escolha a não ser confiar que você tomará boas decisões.

keys: Whatever you do, it won't be as bad as what the person you fought here would have done.
en: Whatever you do, it won't be as bad as what the person you fought here would have done.
pt_BR: O que quer que você faça, não será tão ruim quanto o que a pessoa com quem lutou aqui teria feito.

keys: Be careful. What you have discovered here today has been hidden for thousands of years.
en: Be careful. What you have discovered here today has been hidden for thousands of years.
pt_BR: Tenha cuidado. O que você descobriu aqui hoje esteve escondido por milhares de anos.

keys: As chance has dictated, you are now a warden of a powerful Shambleta.
en: As chance has dictated, you are now a warden of a powerful Shambleta.
pt_BR: Como o acaso determinou, você agora é guardião de uma poderosa Shambleta.

keys: He used to be one of the Manayir. His intentions are different now.
en: He used to be one of the Manayir. His intentions are different now.
pt_BR: Ele já foi um dos Manayir. As intenções dele são outras agora.

keys: You should speak to those who belong to his order. They will tell you who he is.
en: You should speak to those who belong to his order. They will tell you who he is.
pt_BR: Fale com os que pertencem à ordem dele. Eles dirão quem ele é.

keys: My grandad used to work in this mine. When I was younger he would tell me about it.
en: My grandad used to work in this mine. When I was younger he would tell me about it.
pt_BR: Meu avô trabalhava nesta mina. Quando eu era mais novo, ele me contava histórias daqui.

keys: It goes down deep. I wonder how far they want us to go; and I wonder if anything lives down there now.
en: It goes down deep. I wonder how far they want us to go; and I wonder if anything lives down there now.
pt_BR: Ela desce fundo. Imagino até onde quiseram ir; e me pergunto se algo vive lá embaixo agora.

keys: What do you think?
en: What do you think?
pt_BR: O que acha?

keys: I'm not venturing much further if I can help it. Here, I have a spare helmet.
en: I'm not venturing much further if I can help it. Here, I have a spare helmet.
pt_BR: Não vou me arriscar muito mais para frente. Aqui, tenho um capacete reserva.

keys: There's an artisan in Tulimshar who makes these from palm fibers and a cactus-derived resin. Strong stuff. The quenchiest.
en: There's an artisan in Tulimshar who makes these from palm fibers and a cactus-derived resin. Strong stuff. The quenchiest.
pt_BR: Há um artesão em Tulimshar que os faz com fibras de palmeira e uma resina derivada de cactus. Resistente. O mais refrescante.

keys: Never mind. Good luck down there!
en: Never mind. Good luck down there!
pt_BR: Deixa pra lá. Boa sorte lá embaixo!

keys: Hi! I'm Watchman Nathan.
en: Hi! I'm Watchman Nathan.
pt_BR: Oi! Eu sou o Vigia Nathan.

keys: I'm normally guarding the port of Tulimshar, but today I have the honour of GETTING ABSOLUTELY BAKED TO A CRISP OUT HERE.
en: I'm normally guarding the port of Tulimshar, but today I have the honour of GETTING ABSOLUTELY BAKED TO A CRISP OUT HERE.
pt_BR: Normalmente eu guardo o porto de Tulimshar, mas hoje tenho a honra de SER ASSADO ATÉ VIRAR TORRADA AQUI FORA.

keys: Sorry. My bad.
en: Sorry. My bad.
pt_BR: Desculpa. Minha culpa.

keys: The Sun is getting to me.
en: The Sun is getting to me.
pt_BR: O Sol está me pegando.

keys: Oh that's you! Sorry I didn't recognize you with all of this sand.
en: Oh that's you! Sorry I didn't recognize you with all of this sand.
pt_BR: Ah é você! Desculpe, não te reconheci com toda esta areia.

keys: It is indeed! I can see why this place was abandoned.
en: It is indeed! I can see why this place was abandoned.
pt_BR: É mesmo! Dá para entender por que este lugar foi abandonado.

keys: I have sand in my teeth from the storm. I can only imagine what the miners who used to work here went though, walking here every day.
en: I have sand in my teeth from the storm. I can only imagine what the miners who used to work here went though, walking here every day.
pt_BR: Estou com areia nos dentes por causa da tempestade. Só consigo imaginar o que os mineiros que trabalhavam aqui passaram, caminhando até aqui todo dia.

keys: Now those people inside will have to deal with this.
en: Now those people inside will have to deal with this.
pt_BR: Agora essa gente aí dentro vai ter que lidar com isso.

keys: I just hope I can go back to guarding the port. If they station me here permanently I might just go feed myself to a goblin.
en: I just hope I can go back to guarding the port. If they station me here permanently I might just go feed myself to a goblin.
pt_BR: Espero só poder voltar a guardar o porto. Se me lotarem aqui permanentemente, posso acabar me jogando para um goblin.

keys: Really? You don't look like a miner. Where is your pickaxe?
en: Really? You don't look like a miner. Where is your pickaxe?
pt_BR: Sério? Você não parece um mineiro. Onde está sua picareta?

keys: Ah, I see.
en: Ah, I see.
pt_BR: Ah, entendo.

keys: Well, sorry for keeping you. It gets boring standing out here all alone.
en: Well, sorry for keeping you. It gets boring standing out here all alone.
pt_BR: Bem, desculpa por te segurar. Fica entediante ficar aqui fora sozinho o tempo todo.

keys: Come on, go inside. They must be waiting for you.
en: Come on, go inside. They must be waiting for you.
pt_BR: Vamos, entre. Eles devem estar esperando por você.

keys: Well, since you're asking... I could use some extra water!
en: Well, since you're asking... I could use some extra water!
pt_BR: Bem, já que está perguntando... eu poderia usar um pouco mais de água!

keys: There's a well here, but it's been dry for a long time.
en: There's a well here, but it's been dry for a long time.
pt_BR: Tem um poço aqui, mas ele está seco há muito tempo.

keys: I'm going to be honest with you. It's not even for drinking. I have that with me.
en: I'm going to be honest with you. It's not even for drinking. I have that with me.
pt_BR: Vou ser honesto com você. Nem é para beber. Eu tenho a minha.

keys: I just want to pour it on my face so I feel less cooked by this heat.
en: I just want to pour it on my face so I feel less cooked by this heat.
pt_BR: Só quero jogar na minha cara para me sentir menos assado com esse calor.

keys: Is that a silly request?
en: Is that a silly request?
pt_BR: É um pedido bobo?

keys: Oh... I understand. No problem. Forget I even asked.
en: Oh... I understand. No problem. Forget I even asked.
pt_BR: Ah... entendo. Sem problema. Esqueça que perguntei.

keys: I guess this is why they put me out here... I must be so annoying.
en: I guess this is why they put me out here... I must be so annoying.
pt_BR: Acho que é por isso que me colocaram aqui fora... Devo ser muito insuportável.

keys: I knew you'd understand. Hydration is important! I'll be waiting for you, friend.
en: I knew you'd understand. Hydration is important! I'll be waiting for you, friend.
pt_BR: Eu sabia que você entenderia. Hidratação é importante! Estarei esperando por você, amigo.

keys: Not that I can go anywhere, even if I wanted to...
en: Not that I can go anywhere, even if I wanted to...
pt_BR: Não que eu possa ir a lugar algum, mesmo que quisesse...

keys: Did you manage to find a bottle of water?
en: Did you manage to find a bottle of water?
pt_BR: Conseguiu encontrar uma garrafa de água?

keys: Thank you, friend! It's good to have some relief, finally!
en: Thank you, friend! It's good to have some relief, finally!
pt_BR: Obrigado, amigo! Que alívio, finalmente!

keys: That was exactly what I needed. You have no idea.
en: That was exactly what I needed. You have no idea.
pt_BR: Isso foi exatamente o que eu precisava. Você não tem ideia.

keys: Now I just need someone to bring me another one...
en: Now I just need someone to bring me another one...
pt_BR: Agora só preciso que alguém me traga outra...

keys: Help.
en: Help.
pt_BR: Socorro.

keys: Who are you? Please, I need your help!
en: Who are you? Please, I need your help!
pt_BR: Quem é você? Por favor, preciso da sua ajuda!

keys: Oh. I thought that he would leave me to die.
en: Oh. I thought that he would leave me to die.
pt_BR: Ah. Eu achei que ele fosse me deixar morrer.

keys: He seemed to really not care what would happen to me down here when he sent me out alone.
en: He seemed to really not care what would happen to me down here when he sent me out alone.
pt_BR: Ele claramente não ligava para o que aconteceria comigo aqui embaixo quando me mandou sozinho.

keys: I was attacked by... Someone?
en: I was attacked by... Someone?
pt_BR: Fui atacado por... alguém?

keys: I didn't expect to find anyone down here, but there was a strange man wearing a dark robe.
en: I didn't expect to find anyone down here, but there was a strange man wearing a dark robe.
pt_BR: Não esperava encontrar ninguém aqui embaixo, mas havia um homem estranho vestindo um manto escuro.

keys: He seemed to be inspecting the walls of the cave. I tried talking to him, but he immediately attacked me without saying anything.
en: He seemed to be inspecting the walls of the cave. I tried talking to him, but he immediately attacked me without saying anything.
pt_BR: Ele parecia inspecionar as paredes da caverna. Tentei falar com ele, mas ele me atacou na hora, sem dizer nada.

keys: I will be. I need to catch my breath.
en: I will be. I need to catch my breath.
pt_BR: Vou sim. Preciso recuperar o fôlego.

keys: Do you have anything on you that could help?
en: Do you have anything on you that could help?
pt_BR: Você tem algo com você que possa ajudar?

keys: Thank you! I feel much better. I'll rest here for a bit and then make my way out of this place.
en: Thank you! I feel much better. I'll rest here for a bit and then make my way out of this place.
pt_BR: Obrigado! Estou me sentindo muito melhor. Vou descansar aqui um pouco e depois saio deste lugar.

keys: Thanks for saving me! I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
en: Thanks for saving me! I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
pt_BR: Valeu por me salvar! Eu temia que o homem voltasse para me acabar.

keys: That's fine. I will just need to rest here a bit and then I'll be able to make my way out of this place.
en: That's fine. I will just need to rest here a bit and then I'll be able to make my way out of this place.
pt_BR: Tanto faz. Só preciso descansar aqui um pouco e depois conseguirei sair deste lugar.

keys: I'm glad you found me. I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
en: I'm glad you found me. I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
pt_BR: Que bom que me encontrou. Eu temia que o homem voltasse para me acabar.

keys: He walked away following this corridor. The last time I heard him was below this ledge.
en: He walked away following this corridor. The last time I heard him was below this ledge.
pt_BR: Ele seguiu por este corredor. A última vez que o ouvi foi abaixo desta saliência.

keys: It sounded like he was walking in water. Then I heard crumbling rocks.
en: It sounded like he was walking in water. Then I heard crumbling rocks.
pt_BR: Parecia que ele estava andando na água. Depois ouvi pedras desmoronando.

keys: The next time I heard something it turned out to be you walking towards me.
en: The next time I heard something it turned out to be you walking towards me.
pt_BR: Da próxima vez que ouvi algo, era você caminhando na minha direção.

keys: There must be a crack in the walls somewhere below this ledge. That's where he disappeared.
en: There must be a crack in the walls somewhere below this ledge. That's where he disappeared.
pt_BR: Deve haver uma fenda nas paredes em algum lugar abaixo desta saliência. Foi por onde ele desapareceu.

keys: Who are you?
en: Who are you?
pt_BR: Quem é você?

keys: He sent YOU? I told that sand brained idiot to send NEW RECRUITS.
en: He sent YOU? I told that sand brained idiot to send NEW RECRUITS.
pt_BR: Ele mandou VOCÊ? Eu disse àquele idiota de cabeça de areia para mandar RECRUTAS NOVOS.

keys: Not some random desert wanderer.
en: Not some random desert wanderer.
pt_BR: Não algum andarilho qualquer do deserto.

keys: You'll probably be running away at the first sight of a scorpion, won't you?
en: You'll probably be running away at the first sight of a scorpion, won't you?
pt_BR: Provavelmente você sairá correndo na primeira visão de um escorpião, não é?

keys: Right... whatever. Stop talking.
en: Right... whatever. Stop talking.
pt_BR: Certo... tanto faz. Cala a boca.

keys: Your voice is annoying. The last thing I need is to hear it echo through this cave.
en: Your voice is annoying. The last thing I need is to hear it echo through this cave.
pt_BR: Sua voz é irritante. A última coisa que preciso é ouvi-la ecoando por esta caverna.

keys: As you can see I already have some sorry beggars here who are desperate enough to dig through the dirt and see if there's any valuable metals left in this miserable place.
en: As you can see I already have some sorry beggars here who are desperate enough to dig through the dirt and see if there's any valuable metals left in this miserable place.
pt_BR: Como pode ver, já tenho aqui alguns coitados desesperados o bastante para cavar a terra e ver se sobrou algum metal valente neste lugar miserável.

keys: I'm getting to it!
en: I'm getting to it!
pt_BR: Já estou indo!

keys: I have sent one of these idiots to scout ahead, but it seems that he got lost.
en: I have sent one of these idiots to scout ahead, but it seems that he got lost.
pt_BR: Enviei um desses idiotas para explorar à frente, mas parece que ele se perdeu.

keys: His name is Nickos. He hasn't been back for a while.
en: His name is Nickos. He hasn't been back for a while.
pt_BR: O nome dele é Nickos. Ele não volta há algum tempo.

keys: Look for him.
en: Look for him.
pt_BR: Procure por ele.

keys: Bring him back if he's alive. If he's dead, then you will probably die as well and we will know there's danger down there.
en: Bring him back if he's alive. If he's dead, then you will probably die as well and we will know there's danger down there.
pt_BR: Traga-o de volta, se estiver vivo. Se estiver morto, então você provavelmente também morrerá lá, e saberemos que há perigo.

keys: How does that sound?
en: How does that sound?
pt_BR: Que tal?

keys: Good. I wasn't going to give you a choice anyway.
en: Good. I wasn't going to give you a choice anyway.
pt_BR: Bom. Eu não ia te dar escolha de qualquer jeito.

keys: Go! Don't wait for me to kiss you goodbye.
en: Go! Don't wait for me to kiss you goodbye.
pt_BR: Vai! Não espere que eu te dê um beijo de despedida.

keys: You're still alive.
en: You're still alive.
pt_BR: Você ainda está vivo.

keys: I was starting to think you'd gotten lost too. What happened down there?
en: I was starting to think you'd gotten lost too. What happened down there?
pt_BR: Comecei a achar que você também tinha se perdido. O que aconteceu lá embaixo?

keys: Flooded?
en: Flooded?
pt_BR: Inundada?

keys: I wonder where the water came from.
en: I wonder where the water came from.
pt_BR: Imagino de onde veio a água.

keys: There is a well just outside of here, maybe there was underground water nearby.
en: There is a well just outside of here, maybe there was underground water nearby.
pt_BR: Há um poço aqui fora, talvez houvesse água subterrânea por perto.

keys: We should not mess with flooded caves. The tunnels could collapse and trap us all inside. I'll report back that the mine is too far gone.
en: We should not mess with flooded caves. The tunnels could collapse and trap us all inside. I'll report back that the mine is too far gone.
pt_BR: Não devemos mexer em cavernas inundadas. Os túneis podem desmoronar e nos deixar presos aqui dentro. Vou relatar que a mina não tem mais jeito.

keys: Fire-breathing? I have never seen that before.
en: Fire-breathing? I have never seen that before.
pt_BR: Cuspindo fogo? Nunca vi isso antes.

keys: I've seen scorpions down there big enough to swallow a man whole. I guess it wouldn't be so unthinkable for them to breathe fire.
en: I've seen scorpions down there big enough to swallow a man whole. I guess it wouldn't be so unthinkable for them to breathe fire.
pt_BR: Já vi escorpiões aqui embaixo grandes o bastante para engolir um homem inteiro. Imagino que não seja tão impensável que cuspam fogo.

keys: Maybe we should avoid this place. It doesn't seem like we'll find much of use anyway.
en: Maybe we should avoid this place. It doesn't seem like we'll find much of use anyway.
pt_BR: Talvez devêssemos evitar este lugar. Não parece que encontraremos algo útil de qualquer jeito.

keys: G...goblins? Are... are you sure?
en: G...goblins? Are... are you sure?
pt_BR: G... goblins? T... tem certeza?

keys: I'm... I'm not scared! If that's what you were wondering. I AM NOT SCARED OF GOBLINS!
en: I'm... I'm not scared! If that's what you were wondering. I AM NOT SCARED OF GOBLINS!
pt_BR: Eu... eu não estou com medo! Se era isso que você queria saber. EU NÃO TENHO MEDO DE GOBLINS!

keys: You know what? We should just leave this place. Yes, let's just go.
en: You know what? We should just leave this place. Yes, let's just go.
pt_BR: Sabe de uma coisa? Devíamos embora daqui. Sim, vamos só ir embora.

keys: It's way too dangerous down here. It's not worth the risk just to look for forgotten ores.
en: It's way too dangerous down here. It's not worth the risk just to look for forgotten ores.
pt_BR: É perigoso demais aqui embaixo. Não vale o risco só para procurar minérios esquecidos.

keys: A tree. A magical tree. A magical TALKING tree.
en: A tree. A magical tree. A magical TALKING tree.
pt_BR: Árvore. Uma árvore mágica. Uma árvore que FALA.

keys: What's next, you'll tell me the scorpions were breathing fire? Did a goblin sing you a song?
en: What's next, you'll tell me the scorpions were breathing fire? Did a goblin sing you a song?
pt_BR: O que vem agora, vai me dizer que os escorpiões cospem fogo? Que um goblin cantou uma música pra você?

keys: You've lost your mind. Whatever happened down there made you stupid!
en: You've lost your mind. Whatever happened down there made you stupid!
pt_BR: Você perdeu o juízo. O que quer que tenha acontecido lá embaixo te deixou burro!

keys: Maybe this is one of those haunted caves. I'm starting to think we shouldn't go down at all.
en: Maybe this is one of those haunted caves. I'm starting to think we shouldn't go down at all.
pt_BR: Talvez esta seja uma daquelas cavernas assombradas. Estou começando a achar que não devíamos descer.

keys: Speaking of which. What about Nickos? Did you find him?
en: Speaking of which. What about Nickos? Did you find him?
pt_BR: Falando nisso. E o Nickos? Você o encontrou?

keys: No surprise, I've seen him get scared by at the sight of a maggot walking towards him.
en: No surprise, I've seen him get scared by at the sight of a maggot walking towards him.
pt_BR: Sem surpresa; já vi ele se assustar com uma larva andando na direção dele.

keys: He'd better not waste my time up here and get back quickly, or I may just leave him.
en: He'd better not waste my time up here and get back quickly, or I may just leave him.
pt_BR: Melhor ele não perder meu tempo aqui em cima e voltar rápido, ou posso simplesmente ir embora.

keys: Right.
en: Right.
pt_BR: Certo.

keys: He knew the risks. Everyone who does this job knows that.
en: He knew the risks. Everyone who does this job knows that.
pt_BR: Ele conhecia os riscos. Todo mundo que faz esse trabalho sabe disso.

keys: We're not going to get his body. Don't even suggest it.
en: We're not going to get his body. Don't even suggest it.
pt_BR: Não vamos buscar o corpo dele. Nem sugira isso.

keys: If I lose anyone else I'll never be allowed to lead anyone outside the city walls again.
en: If I lose anyone else I'll never be allowed to lead anyone outside the city walls again.
pt_BR: Se eu perder mais alguém, nunca mais me deixaram liderar ninguém para fora das muralhas da cidade.

keys: His pay was his own to collect. Consider it yours for the report.
en: His pay was his own to collect. Consider it yours for the report.
pt_BR: O pagamento dele era dele para recolher. Considere seu, pelo relatório.

keys: At least now I'm sure we won't be going down there. First person I send died. Not a good sign.
en: At least now I'm sure we won't be going down there. First person I send died. Not a good sign.
pt_BR: Pelo menos agora tenho certeza de que não desceremos. A primeira pessoa que enviei morreu. Não é um bom sinal.

keys: If you follow this road the the east you'll be leaving the Tulimshar Valley and heading towards the Manayir Coast.
en: If you follow this road the the east you'll be leaving the Tulimshar Valley and heading towards the Manayir Coast.
pt_BR: Se seguir esta estrada para o leste, deixará o Vale de Tulimshar em direção à Costa de Manayir.

keys: Are you lost?
en: Are you lost?
pt_BR: Você está perdido?

keys: You'll find them directly south of here.
en: You'll find them directly south of here.
pt_BR: Você os encontrará logo ao sul daqui.

keys: They've been abandonded for a long time, but I just saw a group of people heading in that direction earlier.
en: They've been abandonded for a long time, but I just saw a group of people heading in that direction earlier.
pt_BR: Estão abandonadas há muito tempo, mas vi um grupo de pessoas seguindo naquela direção mais cedo.

keys: Looked like Tulimshar folks. I wonder what they're up to...
en: Looked like Tulimshar folks. I wonder what they're up to...
pt_BR: Pareciam gente de Tulimshar. Me pergunto o que estão tramando...

keys: Tulimshar Valley is a low-lying protected area where the city of Tulimshar hides from the open Tonori Desert.
en: Tulimshar Valley is a low-lying protected area where the city of Tulimshar hides from the open Tonori Desert.
pt_BR: O Vale de Tulimshar é uma área baixa e protegida onde a cidade de Tulimshar se esconde do aberto Deserto de Tonori.

keys: The city walls close off the city between the valley and the open sea.
en: The city walls close off the city between the valley and the open sea.
pt_BR: As muralhas fecham a cidade entre o vale e o mar aberto.

keys: Apart from the sand storm that blows through the valley, this area is relatively safe compared to farther parts of Tonori where all sorts of dangers hide among the hot sands.
en: Apart from the sand storm that blows through the valley, this area is relatively safe compared to farther parts of Tonori where all sorts of dangers hide among the hot sands.
pt_BR: Além da tempestade de areia que varre o vale, esta área é relativamente segura comparada a partes mais distantes de Tonori, onde todo tipo de perigo se esconde nas areias quentes.

keys: It's a quiet area of Tonori close to the sea. It probably has the mildest climate out of any area in this desert.
en: It's a quiet area of Tonori close to the sea. It probably has the mildest climate out of any area in this desert.
pt_BR: É uma área tranquila de Tonori, perto do mar. Deve ter o clima mais ameno de toda esta região do deserto.

keys: The most notable feature is the peninsula that extends from the beach.
en: The most notable feature is the peninsula that extends from the beach.
pt_BR: O detalhe mais marcante é a península que se estende a partir da praia.

keys: We call it Nawah in our language. It's where the Manayir Order makes their home.
en: We call it Nawah in our language. It's where the Manayir Order makes their home.
pt_BR: Nós chamamos de Nawah em nossa língua. É onde a Ordem Manayir tem seu lar.

keys: They are a powerful organisation of wise mages and experts of Mana. They have been around for a very long time, almost as long as my people.
en: They are a powerful organisation of wise mages and experts of Mana. They have been around for a very long time, almost as long as my people.
pt_BR: São uma organização poderosa de magos sábios e especialistas em Mana. Existem há muito tempo, quase tanto quanto o meu povo.

keys: Our old tales talk of how they used to rule Tulimshar in ancient times. Now they mostly keep to themselves.
en: Our old tales talk of how they used to rule Tulimshar in ancient times. Now they mostly keep to themselves.
pt_BR: Nossas histórias antigas dizem que eles costumavam governar Tulimshar em tempos ancestrais. Agora, ficam mais entre si.

keys: We trade with them occasionally and we have always shared our knowledge and admiration of The Spirit - Mana - with them.
en: We trade with them occasionally and we have always shared our knowledge and admiration of The Spirit - Mana - with them.
pt_BR: Comerciamos com eles ocasionalmente e sempre compartilhamos nosso conhecimento e admiração pelo Espírito - Mana - com eles.

keys: This place doesn't feel right.
en: This place doesn't feel right.
pt_BR: Este lugar não me parece certo.

keys: It has an eerie feel to it. Maybe it's just because it was abandoned for so long?
en: It has an eerie feel to it. Maybe it's just because it was abandoned for so long?
pt_BR: Tem um ar sinistro. Talvez seja só porque ficou abandonada tanto tempo?

keys: Or maybe it's why it was abandoned in the first place...
en: Or maybe it's why it was abandoned in the first place...
pt_BR: Ou talvez seja exatamente por isso que foi abandonada em primeiro lugar...

keys: I heard some noises coming from further below. I really don't want to go there...
en: I heard some noises coming from further below. I really don't want to go there...
pt_BR: Ouvi barulhos vindo mais lá de baixo. Realmente não quero ir até lá...

keys: You are stronger than I thought.
en: You are stronger than I thought.
pt_BR: Você é mais forte do que eu pensava.

keys: We will meet again...
en: We will meet again...
pt_BR: Nos veremos de novo...

keys: I came here for the Kano. I did not expect to find a living Uru hiding in the dark. How does it survive?
en: I came here for the Kano. I did not expect to find a living Uru hiding in the dark. How does it survive?
pt_BR: Eu vim pelo Kano. Não esperava encontrar um Uru vivo se escondendo no escuro. Como ele sobrevive?

keys: Is it the last one or are there more?
en: Is it the last one or are there more?
pt_BR: É o último ou tem mais?

keys: This is a bad time for you Tulimshar folk to intrude on this place.
en: This is a bad time for you Tulimshar folk to intrude on this place.
pt_BR: Esta é uma péssima hora para vocês, gente de Tulimshar, invadirem este lugar.

keys: I already dealt with one of you earlier, but you followed me too far, I won't be as forgiving with you.
en: I already dealt with one of you earlier, but you followed me too far, I won't be as forgiving with you.
pt_BR: Já cuidei de um de vocês antes, mas você me seguiu longe demais. Não vou ser tão indulgente com você.

keys: You are not supposed to be here. Neither am I, but that doesn't matter.
en: You are not supposed to be here. Neither am I, but that doesn't matter.
pt_BR: Você não deveria estar aqui. Eu também não, mas isso não importa.

keys: I have what I want.
en: I have what I want.
pt_BR: Tenho o que queria.

keys: I don't have time to satisfy your curiosity and I cannot let you leave this place.
en: I don't have time to satisfy your curiosity and I cannot let you leave this place.
pt_BR: Não tenho tempo para satisfazer sua curiosidade, e não posso deixá-lo sair daqui.

keys: Careful where you step. The cacti are just coming in.
en: Careful where you step. The cacti are just coming in.
pt_BR: Cuidado onde pisa. Os cactus estão começando a crescer.

keys: Sorry, I don't get many visitors. Not since I used to be a counsellor up in the palace.
en: Sorry, I don't get many visitors. Not since I used to be a counsellor up in the palace.
pt_BR: Desculpe, não recebo muitas visitas. Não desde que eu era conselheiro lá no palácio.

keys: Quit a few years back. Too much weight on everyone's shoulders up there, you know?
en: Quit a few years back. Too much weight on everyone's shoulders up there, you know?
pt_BR: Larguei há alguns anos. Peso demais nos ombros de todo mundo lá em cima, sabe?

keys: Out here it's just me and the dirt. Farming is useful for the city though, so I don't mind it.
en: Out here it's just me and the dirt. Farming is useful for the city though, so I don't mind it.
pt_BR: Aqui fora sou só eu e a terra. Agricultar é útil para a cidade, então não me importo.

keys: Do you ever run the same scenario over and over in your head and wonder how different things would be if you took a different decision?
en: Do you ever run the same scenario over and over in your head and wonder how different things would be if you took a different decision?
pt_BR: Você já ficou repetindo o mesmo cenário na cabeça, imaginando como as coisas seriam diferentes se tivesse tomado outra decisão?

keys: Still at it? Those corridors aren't friendly.
en: Still at it? Those corridors aren't friendly.
pt_BR: Ainda nisso? Esses corredores não são amigáveis.

keys: You found them. Good, good.
en: You found them. Good, good.
pt_BR: Você os encontrou. Bom, bom.

keys: Bring the sealed letters to Ben. I just saw him walk into the corridor as soon as you left.
en: Bring the sealed letters to Ben. I just saw him walk into the corridor as soon as you left.
pt_BR: Leve as cartas seladas ao Ben. Acabei de vê-lo entrar no corredor quando você saiu.

keys: He has good instincts, or maybe you made noise while focusing on not being seen. Anyway, he'll be in there.
en: He has good instincts, or maybe you made noise while focusing on not being seen. Anyway, he'll be in there.
pt_BR: Ele tem bons instintos, ou talvez você tenha feito barulho enquanto tentava não ser visto. Enfim, ele está aí dentro.

keys: You're back. What did he...
en: You're back. What did he...
pt_BR: Você voltou. O que ele...

keys: This envelope. It's heavy.
en: This envelope. It's heavy.
pt_BR: Este envelope. Está pesado.

keys: Gold. He put gold in here. With my name on it.
en: Gold. He put gold in here. With my name on it.
pt_BR: Ouro. Ele pôs ouro aqui. Com o meu nome.

keys: When the Queen first stationed us together, we each set aside a share for the other. In case things got bad enough that one of us needed to get out.
en: When the Queen first stationed us together, we each set aside a share for the other. In case things got bad enough that one of us needed to get out.
pt_BR: Quando a Rainha nos pôs juntos pela primeira vez, cada um de nós deixou uma parte guardada para o outro. Caso as coisas ficassem ruins o bastante para um de nós precisar sair.

keys: I thought he'd spent this after I left. I would have understood if he did.
en: I thought he'd spent this after I left. I would have understood if he did.
pt_BR: Achei que ele tivesse gastado isso depois que parti. Teria entendido se tivesse.

keys: I don't deserve this. It should belong to someone who is a better friend than I managed to be.
en: I don't deserve this. It should belong to someone who is a better friend than I managed to be.
pt_BR: Não mereço isto. Deveria pertencer a alguém que foi um amigo melhor do que eu consegui ser.

keys: Here. You take it. You've done more for us in one afternoon than we managed in years.
en: Here. You take it. You've done more for us in one afternoon than we managed in years.
pt_BR: Aqui. Você fica com isto. Fez mais por nós em uma tarde do que nós em anos.

keys: Did you find Ben? He's in the western wall corridor.
en: Did you find Ben? He's in the western wall corridor.
pt_BR: Você encontrou o Ben? Ele está no corredor da muralha oeste.

keys: Cacti are coming in nicely this year.
en: Cacti are coming in nicely this year.
pt_BR: Os cactus estão crescendo muito bem este ano.

keys: I keep thinking I should walk over there. To the corridor. Not today, but I decided I will.
en: I keep thinking I should walk over there. To the corridor. Not today, but I decided I will.
pt_BR: Fico pensando em ir até lá. Ao corredor. Hoje não, mas decidi que irei.

keys: He kept those letters. That's something, right?
en: He kept those letters. That's something, right?
pt_BR: Ele guardou aquelas cartas. Isso quer dizer alguma coisa, não quer?

keys: There was someone I worked with. Ben. Brilliant man. Could fix anything, build anything.
en: There was someone I worked with. Ben. Brilliant man. Could fix anything, build anything.
pt_BR: Havia alguém com quem eu trabalhava. Ben. Um homem brilhante. Consertava qualquer coisa, construía qualquer coisa.

keys: Quiet, though. He'd rather tear down a wall and rebuild it than explain why it needed fixing.
en: Quiet, though. He'd rather tear down a wall and rebuild it than explain why it needed fixing.
pt_BR: Reservado, porém. Ele prefere derrubar uma parede e reconstruí-la a explicar por que precisava de conserto.

keys: Me, I was the one who talked to people. Organized shifts, sorted out disagreements, kept things running.
en: Me, I was the one who talked to people. Organized shifts, sorted out disagreements, kept things running.
pt_BR: Eu era quem falava com as pessoas. Organizava escalas, resolvia desavenças, mantinha tudo funcionando.

keys: We held these walls together for years. Under the Queen, that's no small thing.
en: We held these walls together for years. Under the Queen, that's no small thing.
pt_BR: Seguramos estas muralhas juntos por anos. Sob a Rainha, isso não é pouco.

keys: The Queen happened. Or kept happening I guess. Always more demands, always her way.
en: The Queen happened. Or kept happening I guess. Always more demands, always her way.
pt_BR: A Rainha aconteceu. Ou continuou acontecendo, imagino. Sempre mais exigências, sempre do jeito dela.

keys: I started making rules. Procedures for everything. I thought if I could just organize it all, maybe the pressure wouldn't crush us.
en: I started making rules. Procedures for everything. I thought if I could just organize it all, maybe the pressure wouldn't crush us.
pt_BR: Comecei a criar regras. Procedimentos para tudo. Achei que, se conseguisse organizar tudo, talvez a pressão não nos esmagasse.

keys: Ben saw it differently. Said I was piling even more pressure on top of what we were already under.
en: Ben saw it differently. Said I was piling even more pressure on top of what we were already under.
pt_BR: O Ben via diferente. Disse que eu estava acumulando ainda mais pressão sobre o que já enfrentávamos.

keys: And he just did things. Decided things. Without telling me, without telling anyone. I'd find out after the fact.
en: And he just did things. Decided things. Without telling me, without telling anyone. I'd find out after the fact.
pt_BR: E ele simplesmente fazia as coisas. Decidia as coisas. Sem me contar, sem contar a ninguém. Eu ficava sabendo depois.

keys: We were both trying to keep the same walls standing. But somewhere along the way we stopped talking about it and started fighting about it instead.
en: We were both trying to keep the same walls standing. But somewhere along the way we stopped talking about it and started fighting about it instead.
pt_BR: Nós dois tentávamos manter as mesmas muralhas de pé. Mas em algum momento paramos de conversar sobre isso e começamos a brigar por causa disso.

keys: I've made too many mistakes to think I was right about everything. But back then, neither of us would bend.
en: I've made too many mistakes to think I was right about everything. But back then, neither of us would bend.
pt_BR: Cometi erros demais para achar que estava certo sobre tudo. Mas naquela época, nenhum dos dois cedia.

keys: He told me to leave. And I just did. I'm not proud of how I handled it, but I got out of the way.
en: He told me to leave. And I just did. I'm not proud of how I handled it, but I got out of the way.
pt_BR: Ele me disse para ir embora. E eu fui. Não tenho orgulho de como lidamos com isso, mas saí do caminho.

keys: That was years ago. I still think about it more than I should.
en: That was years ago. I still think about it more than I should.
pt_BR: Isso foi há anos. Ainda penso nisso mais do que deveria.

keys: Actually... there might be.
en: Actually... there might be.
pt_BR: Na verdade... talvez haja sim.

keys: At the far end of the western wall corridor near us, past Ben's patrols, there's a small chamber with a library shelf.
en: At the far end of the western wall corridor near us, past Ben's patrols, there's a small chamber with a library shelf.
pt_BR: No fim do corredor da muralha oeste, à nossa esquerda, depois das rondas do Ben, há uma pequena câmara com uma estante de biblioteca.

keys: There's an envelope on that shelf. Letters we wrote each other, back when the Queen had us stationed apart. Before everything went wrong.
en: There's an envelope on that shelf. Letters we wrote each other, back when the Queen had us stationed apart. Before everything went wrong.
pt_BR: Há um envelope naquela estante. Cartas que escrevemos um ao outro, quando a Rainha nos mantinha em postos separados. Antes de tudo dar errado.

keys: I don't know if it'll change anything. But maybe if he read them again he'd remember we weren't always like this.
en: I don't know if it'll change anything. But maybe if he read them again he'd remember we weren't always like this.
pt_BR: Não sei se isso mudará alguma coisa. Mas talvez, se ele as reler, lembre que nem sempre fomos assim.

keys: The corridors are patrolled, though. You should stick to the shadows. If you step into the light, the guards will catch you.
en: The corridors are patrolled, though. You should stick to the shadows. If you step into the light, the guards will catch you.
pt_BR: Os corredores são patrulhados, porém. Fique nas sombras. Se pisar na luz, os guardas te pegam.

keys: Far end of the western wall corridor to our left, on top of the library shelf.
en: Far end of the western wall corridor to our left, on top of the library shelf.
pt_BR: No fim do corredor da muralha oeste, em cima da estante de livros.

keys: And stay out of the light. The guards are on strict orders to escort any unauthorised citizens out.
en: And stay out of the light. The guards are on strict orders to escort any unauthorised citizens out.
pt_BR: E fique fora da luz. Os guardas têm ordens rígidas de escoltar qualquer cidadão não autorizado para fora.

keys: Thank you, really.
en: Thank you, really.
pt_BR: Obrigado, de verdade.

keys: Being stationed in this inner wall section is the best thing you could expect.
en: Being stationed in this inner wall section is the best thing you could expect.
pt_BR: Ficar postado neste trecho da muralha interna é o melhor que você pode esperar.

keys: I can stay in the shade all day and rest while other guards keep the wildlife outside our walls.
en: I can stay in the shade all day and rest while other guards keep the wildlife outside our walls.
pt_BR: Posso ficar na sombra o dia todo descansando enquanto outros guardas mantêm a fauna selvagem do lado de fora das muralhas.

keys: All I have to do is to prevent people from bothering our queen while she works on her garden.
en: All I have to do is to prevent people from bothering our queen while she works on her garden.
pt_BR: Tudo que preciso fazer é impedir que atrapalhem nossa rainha enquanto ela cuida do jardim.

keys: That's the Red Queen's castle.
en: That's the Red Queen's castle.
pt_BR: Aquele é o castelo da Rainha Vermelha.

keys: You can request an audience to Her Majesty if you have something important to say but I wouldn't recommend to distract her from her gardens.
