en: You can request an audience to Her Majesty if you have something important to say but I wouldn't recommend to distract her from her gardens.
pt_BR: Você pode pedir uma audiência com Sua Majestade se tiver algo importante a dizer, mas eu não recomendo distraí-la de seus jardins.

keys: You can also find the second largest library from the continent, it almost matches the number of books from the Manayir tower!
en: You can also find the second largest library from the continent, it almost matches the number of books from the Manayir tower!
pt_BR: Você também encontra aqui a segunda maior biblioteca do continente; quase iguala o número de livros da torre de Manayir!

keys: ARGH.
en: ARGH.
pt_BR: ARGH.

keys: ...Sorry. That region just irritates me.
en: ...Sorry. That region just irritates me.
pt_BR: ...Desculpa. Essa região só me irrita.

keys: It's dangerous. Lots of snakes, and that's the friendly part. Some native people live out there too, I don't want to deal with them, I heard they eat raw birds and dance with their feathers.
en: It's dangerous. Lots of snakes, and that's the friendly part. Some native people live out there too, I don't want to deal with them, I heard they eat raw birds and dance with their feathers.
pt_BR: É perigoso. Muitas cobras, e essa é a parte simpática. Tem gente nativa vivendo lá fora também; não quero lidar com eles. Dizem que comem pássaros crus e dançam com as penas.

keys: Stick to the paths if you have to go. Better yet, don't.
en: Stick to the paths if you have to go. Better yet, don't.
pt_BR: Fique nos caminhos se precisar ir. Melhor ainda: não vá.

keys: You can find our old cactus fields and habitation outside these walls, they are completely uninhabited.
en: You can find our old cactus fields and habitation outside these walls, they are completely uninhabited.
pt_BR: Você pode encontrar nossos antigos campos de cactus e habitações fora destas muralhas; estão completamente desabitados.

keys: The sandstorm ate all of it and forced us to barricade ourselves at the end of the valley.
en: The sandstorm ate all of it and forced us to barricade ourselves at the end of the valley.
pt_BR: A tempestade de areia engoliu tudo e nos forçou a nos barricarmos no fim do vale.

keys: That's not ideal as that sandstorm keeps getting bigger year after year.
en: That's not ideal as that sandstorm keeps getting bigger year after year.
pt_BR: Não é ideal, já que aquela tempestade de areia cresce ano após ano.

keys: Have you seen my chalk?
en: Have you seen my chalk?
pt_BR: Você viu meu giz?

keys: I bet the guards took it to play with on their own.
en: I bet the guards took it to play with on their own.
pt_BR: Aposto que os guardas levaram para brincar.

keys: One day, I'm going to the sea to explore the world.
en: One day, I'm going to the sea to explore the world.
pt_BR: Um dia eu vou ao mar para explorar o mundo.

keys: I heard there's a city to the north with cold, white sand.
en: I heard there's a city to the north with cold, white sand.
pt_BR: Ouvi dizer que há uma cidade ao norte com areia branca e fria.

keys: Can you draw a perfect circle? I can! My dad taught me.
en: Can you draw a perfect circle? I can! My dad taught me.
pt_BR: Você consegue desenhar um círculo perfeito? Eu consigo! Meu pai me ensinou.

keys: Wie can't draw circles. When she tries they look like fat squares.
en: Wie can't draw circles. When she tries they look like fat squares.
pt_BR: A Wie não consegue desenhar círculos. Quando tenta, ficam quadrados gordinhos.

keys: They look so funny, but she doesn't like when I laugh at them, so she always wants to be the X.
en: They look so funny, but she doesn't like when I laugh at them, so she always wants to be the X.
pt_BR: Elas parecem tão engraçadas, mas ela não gosta quando eu rio, então ela sempre quer ser o X.

keys: I started calling her "the wild X".
en: I started calling her "the wild X".
pt_BR: Comecei a chamá-la de “X selvagem”.

keys: You look like you want to say something. But your hands are empty.
en: You look like you want to say something. But your hands are empty.
pt_BR: Parece que você quer dizer alguma coisa. Mas suas mãos estão vazias.

keys: Come back when you've got something to show me. I have work to do.
en: Come back when you've got something to show me. I have work to do.
pt_BR: Volte quando tiver algo para me mostrar. Tenho trabalho a fazer.

keys: What. He sent you here with these?
en: What. He sent you here with these?
pt_BR: O quê. Ele mandou você aqui com estas coisas?

keys: I know this handwriting.
en: I know this handwriting.
pt_BR: Reconheço esta letra.

keys: These are old. Back when the Queen had us stationed apart, before we even shared the same wall.
en: These are old. Back when the Queen had us stationed apart, before we even shared the same wall.
pt_BR: São antigas. De quando a Rainha nos mantinha separados, antes até de dividirmos a mesma muralha.

keys: Frost handled the people. I handled the stone. That was the deal.
en: Frost handled the people. I handled the stone. That was the deal.
pt_BR: O Frost cuidava das pessoas. Eu cuidava da pedra. Esse era o acordo.

keys: It worked, for a while.
en: It worked, for a while.
pt_BR: Funcionou, por um tempo.

keys: Then the Queen kept pushing. More demands, always her way. No room to just do the work.
en: Then the Queen kept pushing. More demands, always her way. No room to just do the work.
pt_BR: Então a Rainha continuou pressionando. Mais exigências, sempre do jeito dela. Sem espaço para simplesmente fazer o trabalho.

keys: Frost started making rules. Procedures for everything. I told him we didn't need more pressure on top of what we already dealt with.
en: Frost started making rules. Procedures for everything. I told him we didn't need more pressure on top of what we already dealt with.
pt_BR: O Frost começou a criar regras. Procedimentos para tudo. Eu disse que não precisávamos de mais pressão sobre o que já enfrentávamos.

keys: He said I was shutting him out, making decisions without telling anyone.
en: He said I was shutting him out, making decisions without telling anyone.
pt_BR: Ele dizia que eu o estava excluindo, tomando decisões sem contar a ninguém.

keys: Maybe I was, words aren't my tool. Never were.
en: Maybe I was, words aren't my tool. Never were.
pt_BR: Talvez eu fosse. Palavras não são minha ferramenta. Nunca foram.

keys: I just wanted to build things and have people stop arguing about how I build them.
en: I just wanted to build things and have people stop arguing about how I build them.
pt_BR: Eu só queria construir coisas e fazer as pessoas pararem de discutir sobre como eu as construo.

keys: Anyway. I told him to leave. He left. End of story.
en: Anyway. I told him to leave. He left. End of story.
pt_BR: Enfim. Eu disse para ele ir embora. Ele foi. Fim da história.

keys: Except it wasn't, obviously. Because here I am, guarding walls nobody's trying to break through.
en: Except it wasn't, obviously. Because here I am, guarding walls nobody's trying to break through.
pt_BR: Só que não foi, óbvio. Porque aqui estou eu, guardando muralhas que ninguém tenta invadir.

keys: Except for you... but I guess Frost sent you, so it's different.
en: Except for you... but I guess Frost sent you, so it's different.
pt_BR: Exceto você... mas imagino que o Frost tenha mandado você, então é diferente.

keys: Take this envelope back to him. He'll know what's inside.
en: Take this envelope back to him. He'll know what's inside.
pt_BR: Leve este envelope de volta a ele. Ele saberá o que há dentro.

keys: And tell him the walls still stand. He'll... Yeah. Tell him that.
en: And tell him the walls still stand. He'll... Yeah. Tell him that.
pt_BR: E diga a ele que as muralhas ainda estão de pé. Ele... É. Diga isso a ele.

keys: You again. Corridors are open to you now, I meant that.
en: You again. Corridors are open to you now, I meant that.
pt_BR: Você de novo. Os corredores estão abertos a você agora, é isso que eu quis dizer.

keys: There's a passage behind the library next to me. Goes outside the walls. Not many know about it.
en: There's a passage behind the library next to me. Goes outside the walls. Not many know about it.
pt_BR: Há uma passagem atrás da biblioteca ao meu lado. Dá para fora das muralhas. Poucos conhecem.

keys: You are already up?
en: You are already up?
pt_BR: Já está de pé?

keys: Be sure to talk to Elanore, she took care of you while you were passed out after we found you.
en: Be sure to talk to Elanore, she took care of you while you were passed out after we found you.
pt_BR: Não deixe de falar com a Elanore; ela cuidou de você enquanto você estava desacordado, depois que te encontramos.

keys: Have you seen the maggots we have to deal with?
en: Have you seen the maggots we have to deal with?
pt_BR: Viu as larvas que temos que combater?

keys: Disgusting creatures. They say that in the past they used to be smaller.
en: Disgusting creatures. They say that in the past they used to be smaller.
pt_BR: Criaturas nojentas. Dizem que antigamente elas eram menores.

keys: Our cactus farmers are the most affected by them. The recent increase in the maggots' population has caused a lot of damage to their crops.
en: Our cactus farmers are the most affected by them. The recent increase in the maggots' population has caused a lot of damage to their crops.
pt_BR: Nossos cultivadores de cactus são os mais afetados. O aumento recente na população de larvas causou muitos danos às plantações.

keys: Watchman Kael is stationed east of here, by one of the cactus farms.
en: Watchman Kael is stationed east of here, by one of the cactus farms.
pt_BR: O Vigia Kael está postado a leste daqui, perto de uma das plantações de cactus.

keys: If you want to be useful and repay the debt you owe us you should help Kael clear out some maggots.
en: If you want to be useful and repay the debt you owe us you should help Kael clear out some maggots.
pt_BR: Se quiser ser útil e pagar a dívida que tem conosco, ajude o Kael a limpar umas larvas.

keys: Where do you think you are going?
en: Where do you think you are going?
pt_BR: Pensa que está indo aonde?

keys: Mmh... I see.
en: Mmh... I see.
pt_BR: Mmh... Entendo.

keys: To repay your debt toward the city and if you really want to leave this place I will enlist you to an expedition outside the city.
en: To repay your debt toward the city and if you really want to leave this place I will enlist you to an expedition outside the city.
pt_BR: Para pagar sua dívida com a cidade, e se você realmente quer partir daqui, vou recrutá-lo para uma expedição fora da cidade.

keys: Did you take care of those maggots?
en: Did you take care of those maggots?
pt_BR: Você cuidou daquelas larvas?

keys: Mmh... He's right.
en: Mmh... He's right.
pt_BR: Mmh... Ele está certo.

keys: We do need one more fighter and I was worried about taking too many guards away from their posts here in the city.
en: We do need one more fighter and I was worried about taking too many guards away from their posts here in the city.
pt_BR: Realmente precisamos de mais um lutador, e eu estava preocupado em tirar guardas demais de seus postos aqui na cidade.

keys: You're going to be heading South, towards the Sandstorm Mines.
en: You're going to be heading South, towards the Sandstorm Mines.
pt_BR: Você vai descer para o sul, em direção às Minas da Tempestade.

keys: They're called that for a reason, you know? That area of the desert is prone to strong winds and the swirling sands tend to make it difficult to get to.
en: They're called that for a reason, you know? That area of the desert is prone to strong winds and the swirling sands tend to make it difficult to get to.
pt_BR: Elas têm esse nome por um motivo, sabia? Aquela área do deserto é propensa a ventos fortes, e as areias girantes dificultam a chegada.

keys: This particular storm is different though. It's unusually intense, hot and long-lasting. I wonder if something out there is causing it...
en: This particular storm is different though. It's unusually intense, hot and long-lasting. I wonder if something out there is causing it...
pt_BR: Esta tempestade em particular, porém, é diferente. Está invulgarmente intensa, quente e duradoura. Será que algo lá fora a está causando...

keys: The mines used to be a rich source of Iron Ore, very lucrative business for the Red Queen since the whole area is her private property.
en: The mines used to be a rich source of Iron Ore, very lucrative business for the Red Queen since the whole area is her private property.
pt_BR: As minas já foram uma rica fonte de Iron Ore, negócio muito lucrativo para a Rainha Vermelha, já que toda a área é propriedade privada dela.

keys: They've been abandoned for a few years now as the sandstorm intensified, that area got more dangerous to traverse and miners were dying either to the sand storms or to the angry creatures that wander the desert.
en: They've been abandoned for a few years now as the sandstorm intensified, that area got more dangerous to traverse and miners were dying either to the sand storms or to the angry creatures that wander the desert.
pt_BR: Estão abandonadas há alguns anos, conforme a tempestade de areia intensificou; a área ficou mais perigosa de atravessar e mineiros morriam tanto pelas tempestades quanto pelas criaturas irritadas que vagam pelo deserto.

keys: It seems that our hopeless royalty is running low on funds now. She has ordered the mines to be reopened at all costs.
en: It seems that our hopeless royalty is running low on funds now. She has ordered the mines to be reopened at all costs.
pt_BR: Parece que nossa realeza desesperada está ficando sem fundos. Ela ordenou que as minas fossem reabertas a qualquer custo.

keys: As usual she didn't even consider the danger it poses to the people she wants to send there to work.
en: As usual she didn't even consider the danger it poses to the people she wants to send there to work.
pt_BR: Como sempre, ela nem considerou o perigo que isso representa para as pessoas que quer mandar para trabalhar lá.

keys: Your job will be to scout the area and make sure the old cave system is clear of major dangers. If all is well, we will start bringing in miners and restart the whole operation.
en: Your job will be to scout the area and make sure the old cave system is clear of major dangers. If all is well, we will start bringing in miners and restart the whole operation.
pt_BR: Seu trabalho será explorar a área e garantir que o antigo sistema de cavernas esteja livre de grandes perigos. Se estiver tudo bem, traremos mineiros e reiniciaremos toda a operação.

keys: But before you go, you can't leave without any protection.
en: But before you go, you can't leave without any protection.
pt_BR: Mas antes de ir, você não pode sair sem nenhuma proteção.

keys: Take these. You will need it out there!
en: Take these. You will need it out there!
pt_BR: Leve isto. Vai precisar lá fora!

keys: That should be enough to protect yourself
en: That should be enough to protect yourself
pt_BR: Isso deve bastar para se proteger

keys: But if you are in danger, remember to run away, there is no pride in being dead.
en: But if you are in danger, remember to run away, there is no pride in being dead.
pt_BR: Mas se estiver em perigo, lembre-se de fugir; não há orgulho em estar morto.

keys: You should be all set now.
en: You should be all set now.
pt_BR: Agora você está pronto para tudo.

keys: But one more thing. Before you leave the city, have a word with Gilgames over there. He is guarding the gate and is always willing to speak with new recruits.
en: But one more thing. Before you leave the city, have a word with Gilgames over there. He is guarding the gate and is always willing to speak with new recruits.
pt_BR: Mas mais uma coisa. Antes de sair da cidade, converse com o Gilgames ali. Ele guarda o portão e está sempre disposto a falar com recrutas novos.

keys: Some other guards have already gone ahead. Ask Watchman Dausen outside of the gates and he will tell you where to go.
en: Some other guards have already gone ahead. Ask Watchman Dausen outside of the gates and he will tell you where to go.
pt_BR: Outros guardas já saíram na frente. Pergunte ao Vigia Dausen lá fora dos portões e ele dirá para onde ir.

keys: Strike first.
en: Strike first.
pt_BR: Bata primeiro.

keys: If your opponent is no match, run for your life. There is no pride in being dead.
en: If your opponent is no match, run for your life. There is no pride in being dead.
pt_BR: Se o oponente não for páreo para você... fuja. Não há orgulho em estar morto.

keys: The "Red Queen", more formally known as Queen Karolina I, is the useless ruler of this city.
en: The "Red Queen", more formally known as Queen Karolina I, is the useless ruler of this city.
pt_BR: A “Rainha Vermelha”, mais formalmente conhecida como Rainha Karolina I, é a governante inútil desta cidade.

keys: In fact, she claims to be Queen of Tonori. As if she could control anything beyond the city walls.
en: In fact, she claims to be Queen of Tonori. As if she could control anything beyond the city walls.
pt_BR: Na verdade, ela se proclama Rainha de Tonori. Como se pudesse controlar algo além das muralhas da cidade.

keys: She claims to descend from the Platinum Dynasty, rulers of Tulimshar thousands of years ago. In reality we all know her father was a cactus farmer and she's only Queen because he was a very clever man.
en: She claims to descend from the Platinum Dynasty, rulers of Tulimshar thousands of years ago. In reality we all know her father was a cactus farmer and she's only Queen because he was a very clever man.
pt_BR: Ela diz descender da Dinastia de Platina, governantes de Tulimshar há milhares de anos. Na verdade, todos sabemos que o pai dela era um cultivador de cactus, e ela só é rainha porque ele foi um homem muito astuto.

keys: Yes. He managed to convince the old dying king that he was his bastard son.
en: Yes. He managed to convince the old dying king that he was his bastard son.
pt_BR: Sim. Ele conseguiu convencer o velho rei agonizante de que era seu filho bastardo.

keys: The old man had no other kids and took a liking to him. Before dying he named him his heir. He was actually a very smart man and a good leader so the palace folk just went with it.
en: The old man had no other kids and took a liking to him. Before dying he named him his heir. He was actually a very smart man and a good leader so the palace folk just went with it.
pt_BR: O velho não tinha outros filhos e criou afeto por ele. Antes de morrer, o nomeou herdeiro. Era na verdade um homem muito inteligente e um bom líder, então a gente do palácio aceitou.

keys: Now he's dead too and his useless daughter is making up stories about her supposed royal bloodline. The truth is that nobody likes her and she needs an excuse so that they let her keep wearing that crown.
en: Now he's dead too and his useless daughter is making up stories about her supposed royal bloodline. The truth is that nobody likes her and she needs an excuse so that they let her keep wearing that crown.
pt_BR: Agora ele também está morto e sua filha inútil anda inventando histórias sobre sua suposta linhagem real. A verdade é que ninguém gosta dela, e ela precisa de uma desculpa para continuar usando aquela coroa.

keys: That's an understatement!
en: That's an understatement!
pt_BR: Isso é pouco!

keys: I'd like to see her half-buried in the sands with scorpions poking at her corpse.
en: I'd like to see her half-buried in the sands with scorpions poking at her corpse.
pt_BR: Queria vê-la meio enterrada na areia com escorpiões cutucando seu cadáver.

keys: Don't go around saying I told you that, though.
en: Don't go around saying I told you that, though.
pt_BR: Mas não vá por aí dizendo que fui eu que contei.

keys: She's a cold-hearted, uncaring and selfish person. She spends all her time tending to her garden within the Royal Palace.
en: She's a cold-hearted, uncaring and selfish person. She spends all her time tending to her garden within the Royal Palace.
pt_BR: Ela é uma pessoa de coração frio, indiferente e egoísta. Passa todo o tempo cuidando do jardim dentro do Palácio Real.

keys: She cares more for that silly garden of hers than she does for the lives of any of us.
en: She cares more for that silly garden of hers than she does for the lives of any of us.
pt_BR: Ela se importa mais com aquele jardim bobo dela do que com a vida de qualquer um de nós.

keys: Report back to Watchman Dausen outside of the gates when you're ready to head out.
en: Report back to Watchman Dausen outside of the gates when you're ready to head out.
pt_BR: Reporte-se ao Vigia Dausen lá fora dos portões quando estiver pronto para partir.

keys: You've been lucky we found you before a goblin does but it's great to see you are doing better now.
en: You've been lucky we found you before a goblin does but it's great to see you are doing better now.
pt_BR: Você teve sorte de nós te encontrarmos antes de um goblin, mas que ótimo ver que está melhorando.

keys: Is there something else on your mind?
en: Is there something else on your mind?
pt_BR: Tem mais alguma coisa em mente?

keys: Welcome back. What can I do for you?
en: Welcome back. What can I do for you?
pt_BR: Bem-vindo de volta. Em que posso ajudar?

keys: Hello, welcome to Tulimshar!
en: Hello, welcome to Tulimshar!
pt_BR: Olá, bem-vindo a Tulimshar!

keys: You made it to the gates just in time. The guards found you on the ground, barely within sight.
en: You made it to the gates just in time. The guards found you on the ground, barely within sight.
pt_BR: Você chegou aos portões bem a tempo. Os guardas te encontraram no chão, quase fora de vista.

keys: My name is Elanore. How are you feeling? You'll need to drink this water and please eat this as well, it will make you feel better.
en: My name is Elanore. How are you feeling? You'll need to drink this water and please eat this as well, it will make you feel better.
pt_BR: Meu nome é Elanore. Como você está se sentindo? Precisa beber esta água e comer isto também; vai te fazer bem.

keys: Oh... Okay. Here, take one of these. Beyond that, you're going to need to take some time, darling.
en: Oh... Okay. Here, take one of these. Beyond that, you're going to need to take some time, darling.
pt_BR: Ah... Tá bom. Aqui, pegue um destes. Além disso, vai precisar ter calma, querido.

keys: What were you doing wandering in the desert? It's been dangerous lately, you shouldn't go out there alone.
en: What were you doing wandering in the desert? It's been dangerous lately, you shouldn't go out there alone.
pt_BR: O que você estava fazendo vagando no deserto? Está perigoso ultimamente; não deveria sair sozinho.

keys: Well, it's good to have you here. The city needs capable people to help keep it safe.
en: Well, it's good to have you here. The city needs capable people to help keep it safe.
pt_BR: Bem, que bom ter você aqui. A cidade precisa de gente capaz para manter sua segurança.

keys: Recently the desert has gotten more dangerous. A group of fanatics obsessed with Kaore has been hiding in the mountains to the east. They have been launching assaults on travellers and once during a major battle they came close to breaching the city wall.
en: Recently the desert has gotten more dangerous. A group of fanatics obsessed with Kaore has been hiding in the mountains to the east. They have been launching assaults on travellers and once during a major battle they came close to breaching the city wall.
pt_BR: Recentemente o deserto ficou mais perigoso. Um grupo de fanáticos obcecados por Kaore se esconde nas montanhas a leste. Andam atacando viajantes e, numa grande batalha, chegaram perto de romper a muralha da cidade.

keys: Anyway, here are some basic clothes to replace the rags we found you in.
en: Anyway, here are some basic clothes to replace the rags we found you in.
pt_BR: Enfim, aqui estão algumas roupas básicas para trocar os trapos em que encontramos você.

keys: Before I let you go, allow me to walk you through a few things that will help keep you alive out there.
en: Before I let you go, allow me to walk you through a few things that will help keep you alive out there.
pt_BR: Antes de deixar você ir, deixe-me explicar algumas coisas que vão te ajudar a sobreviver lá fora.

keys: Yes! I make lots of Healing Potions for our guards and the people of this city. They're quick remedies for most ailments and really help keep our people safer.
en: Yes! I make lots of Healing Potions for our guards and the people of this city. They're quick remedies for most ailments and really help keep our people safer.
pt_BR: Sim! Faço muitas Poções de Cura para nossos guardas e o povo desta cidade. São remédios rápidos para a maioria dos males e ajudam muito a manter nosso povo mais seguro.

keys: Healing Potions require knowledge to make and also some key ingredients. Maybe you could get back on your feet by helping me gather some of these ingredients?
en: Healing Potions require knowledge to make and also some key ingredients. Maybe you could get back on your feet by helping me gather some of these ingredients?
pt_BR: Poções de Cura exigem conhecimento e alguns ingredientes-chave. Talvez você possa se reerguer me ajudando a juntar alguns desses ingredientes?

keys: I need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya. Bring those to me and I will make you a Cactus Potion in return.
en: I need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya. Bring those to me and I will make you a Cactus Potion in return.
pt_BR: Preciso de seis Maggot Slimes, uma Water e uma Pitaya. Traga-as e farei uma Cactus Potion em troca.

keys: I still need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya. Come back when you have them.
en: I still need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya. Come back when you have them.
pt_BR: Ainda preciso de seis Maggot Slimes, uma Water e uma Pitaya. Volte quando as tiver.

keys: Thank you for your help. I'll get to work on making new healing potions right away!
en: Thank you for your help. I'll get to work on making new healing potions right away!
pt_BR: Obrigado pela sua ajuda. Já vou começar a fazer novas Poções de Cura!

keys: Helping the people out here is much better than being stuck in some tower or palace. More of the leaders of this city should think about that.
en: Helping the people out here is much better than being stuck in some tower or palace. More of the leaders of this city should think about that.
pt_BR: Ajudar o povo aqui fora é muito melhor do que ficar preso em alguma torre ou palácio. Mais líderes desta cidade deveriam pensar nisso.

keys: Mana is the life energy that connects us all. Kaore is a decayed form of Mana that corrupts life rather than invigorating it. There is much more to it, but that's the general idea.
en: Mana is the life energy that connects us all. Kaore is a decayed form of Mana that corrupts life rather than invigorating it. There is much more to it, but that's the general idea.
pt_BR: Mana é a energia vital que nos conecta. Kaore é uma forma degradada de Mana que corrompe a vida em vez de vigorizá-la. Há muito mais, mas essa é a ideia geral.

keys: If you want to know more, you'd better ask my apprentice, Nina. She is currently overseeing the city's Soul Menhir. You can learn a lot more from her.
en: If you want to know more, you'd better ask my apprentice, Nina. She is currently overseeing the city's Soul Menhir. You can learn a lot more from her.
pt_BR: Se quiser saber mais, pergunte à minha aprendiz, Nina. Ela está supervisionando o Soul Menhir da cidade. Você aprenderá muito mais com ela.

keys: My name is Elanore. I am the Kahwe of this city and the land that surrounds it. Those outside of our order call us Druids. I represent the Kaumatua, an order devoted to the most ancient tradition in our world.
en: My name is Elanore. I am the Kahwe of this city and the land that surrounds it. Those outside of our order call us Druids. I represent the Kaumatua, an order devoted to the most ancient tradition in our world.
pt_BR: Meu nome é Elanore. Sou a Kahwe desta cidade e das terras ao redor. Quem é de fora da nossa ordem nos chama de Druidas. Represento os Kaumatua, uma ordem devotada à tradição mais antiga do nosso mundo.

keys: But don't you worry about that right now. We can chat more later. Right now I am just out here giving a hand with potions and receiving the injured from outside the walls.
en: But don't you worry about that right now. We can chat more later. Right now I am just out here giving a hand with potions and receiving the injured from outside the walls.
pt_BR: Mas não se preocupe com isso agora. Podemos conversar mais depois. Agora estou aqui só dando uma mão com as poções e recebendo os feridos de fora das muralhas.

keys: But I should not keep you here all day. You are new to the city and will want to find your footing.
en: But I should not keep you here all day. You are new to the city and will want to find your footing.
pt_BR: Mas não devo te prender aqui o dia todo. Você é novo na cidade e vai querer se firmar.

keys: Watchman Kael is currently in charge of the local patrol from within our wall, you should speak to him if you're looking for work.
en: Watchman Kael is currently in charge of the local patrol from within our wall, you should speak to him if you're looking for work.
pt_BR: O Vigia Kael está atualmente no comando da patrulha local dentro da nossa muralha; fale com ele se estiver procurando trabalho.

keys: He is standing northeast from here near some palm trees.
en: He is standing northeast from here near some palm trees.
pt_BR: Ele está parado ao nordeste daqui, perto de umas palmeiras.

keys: Just follow this wall to the corner and walk up.
en: Just follow this wall to the corner and walk up.
pt_BR: Basta seguir esta muralha até a esquina e subir.

keys: Hey! Are you new to the city? I don't think I've seen you before. My name is Eridu. I'm a glassmaker.
en: Hey! Are you new to the city? I don't think I've seen you before. My name is Eridu. I'm a glassmaker.
pt_BR: Ei! Você é novo na cidade? Acho que nunca te vi. Meu nome é Eridu. Sou vidreiro.

keys: My family has always made glass. People find it useful to carry liquids out in this climate. That's why we mainly make bottles.
en: My family has always made glass. People find it useful to carry liquids out in this climate. That's why we mainly make bottles.
pt_BR: Minha família sempre fez vidro. As pessoas acham útil carregar líquidos neste clima. Por isso fazemos principalmente garrafas.

keys: We make our glass from the sand of Tonori. We also use salt, bones and sulphur powder.
en: We make our glass from the sand of Tonori. We also use salt, bones and sulphur powder.
pt_BR: Fazemos nosso vidro com a areia de Tonori. Também usamos sal, ossos e pó de enxofre.

keys: The sand is everywhere, as you can see, but the other components are harder to come by.
en: The sand is everywhere, as you can see, but the other components are harder to come by.
pt_BR: A areia está em todo lugar, como pode ver, mas os outros componentes são mais difíceis de conseguir.

keys: You seem to be carrying a lot of stuff. Maybe get rid of some of that and come back.
en: You seem to be carrying a lot of stuff. Maybe get rid of some of that and come back.
pt_BR: Você parece carregar coisas demais. Talvez se livre de algumas e volte.

keys: Salt, bones, sulphur. You seem to have everything!
en: Salt, bones, sulphur. You seem to have everything!
pt_BR: Sal, ossos, enxofre. Parece que você tem tudo!

keys: I'll get to making some new bottles right away.
en: I'll get to making some new bottles right away.
pt_BR: Já vou começar a fazer umas garrafas novas.

keys: Meanwhile, I used up my last resources to make these. Take them.
en: Meanwhile, I used up my last resources to make these. Take them.
pt_BR: Enquanto isso, usei meus últimos recursos para fazer estes. Pegue-os.

keys: %d bottles. Don't break them, they're fine Eridu glass!
en: %d bottles. Don't break them, they're fine Eridu glass!
pt_BR: %d garrafas. Não quebre, são vidro fino do Eridu!

keys: Bring me more materials any time. %d of each, and I will blow some more glass for you.
en: Bring me more materials any time. %d of each, and I will blow some more glass for you.
pt_BR: Traga mais materiais quando quiser. %d de cada, e eu sopra mais vidro para você.

keys: Still short, by my eye. %d of each material. Anything less and the mix won't work.
en: Still short, by my eye. %d of each material. Anything less and the mix won't work.
pt_BR: Ainda está curto, pelo que vejo. %d de cada material. Menos que isso e a mistura não funciona.

keys: Take your time. The furnace is not going anywhere and neither am I.
en: Take your time. The furnace is not going anywhere and neither am I.
pt_BR: Sem pressa. A fornalha não vai a lugar nenhum, e eu também não.

keys: Back for some glass? Good to see you.
en: Back for some glass? Good to see you.
pt_BR: Voltou por causa do vidro? Bom te ver.

keys: Need anything else?
en: Need anything else?
pt_BR: Precisa de mais alguma coisa?

keys: Sand is the glass. We melt it and then we cool down the resulting liquid.
en: Sand is the glass. We melt it and then we cool down the resulting liquid.
pt_BR: A areia é o vidro. Derretemos e depois esfriamos o líquido resultante.

keys: I have plenty of that, as you can see.
en: I have plenty of that, as you can see.
pt_BR: Disso eu tenho de sobra, como pode ver.

keys: We use salt to bring down the melting temperature, so that it's not too hot for our clay pots.
en: We use salt to bring down the melting temperature, so that it's not too hot for our clay pots.
pt_BR: Usamos sal para baixar a temperatura de fusão, para não ficar quente demais para nossos potes de barro.

keys: Then, we add calcium. That's the bones, crushed into a powder. This is essential so that the glass does not melt when in contact with water.
en: Then, we add calcium. That's the bones, crushed into a powder. This is essential so that the glass does not melt when in contact with water.
pt_BR: Depois adicionamos cálcio. São os ossos, moídos em pó. Essencial para que o vidro não derreta em contato com a água.

keys: Finally, sulphur clears the bubbles and takes the green out.
en: Finally, sulphur clears the bubbles and takes the green out.
pt_BR: Por fim, o enxofre clareia as bolhas e tira o verde.

keys: Get the balance wrong and your glass will be weak. Or worse, ugly.
en: Get the balance wrong and your glass will be weak. Or worse, ugly.
pt_BR: Errar a proporção e o vidro fica fraco. Ou pior, feio.

keys: Slimes often have high concentration of salts. Sometimes salt crystals form inside them. It's not easier than letting sea water dry, but it can be faster.
en: Slimes often have high concentration of salts. Sometimes salt crystals form inside them. It's not easier than letting sea water dry, but it can be faster.
pt_BR: Slimes costumam ter alta concentração de sais. Às vezes cristais de sal se formam dentro delas. Não é mais fácil que deixar a água do mar secar, mas pode ser mais rápido.

keys: Sulphur is trickier. The fire goblins out by the sandstorm carry it. I think that their body makes it. Maybe to produce their fire?
en: Sulphur is trickier. The fire goblins out by the sandstorm carry it. I think that their body makes it. Maybe to produce their fire?
pt_BR: O enxofre é mais complicado. Os goblins de fogo das tempestades de areia carregam. Acho que o corpo deles produz. Talvez para gerar o fogo?

keys: Bones will need to come from the reanimated corpses that wander certain areas. I've heard they're created by Kaore. Certainly better than digging into graves.
en: Bones will need to come from the reanimated corpses that wander certain areas. I've heard they're created by Kaore. Certainly better than digging into graves.
pt_BR: Osses precisam vir dos corpos reanimados que vagam por certas áreas. Dizem que são criados pela Kaore. Certo que é melhor que cavar túmulos.

keys: Good. You have everything.
en: Good. You have everything.
pt_BR: Bom. Você tem tudo.

keys: Bring them here and I will put %d bottles in your hands before they have finished cooling.
en: Bring them here and I will put %d bottles in your hands before they have finished cooling.
pt_BR: Traga-os aqui e eu colocarei %d garrafas nas suas mãos antes que terminem de esfriar.

keys: Suit yourself. The furnace keeps burning either way.
en: Suit yourself. The furnace keeps burning either way.
pt_BR: Você quem sabe. A fornalha continua acesa de qualquer jeito.

keys: It takes %d Salt, %d Bone and %d Sulphur Powder for one bottle. Twice that and you get two. It's simple, really.
en: It takes %d Salt, %d Bone and %d Sulphur Powder for one bottle. Twice that and you get two. It's simple, really.
pt_BR: Leva %d Salt, %d Bone e %d Sulphur Powder para uma garrafa. O dobro e você leva duas. É simples, na verdade.

keys: Let me weigh what you have brought...
en: Let me weigh what you have brought...
pt_BR: Deixe-me pesar o que você trouxe...

keys: Your bag is fit to burst. How are you going to put glass in there? Go empty some stuff out!
en: Your bag is fit to burst. How are you going to put glass in there? Go empty some stuff out!
pt_BR: Sua bolsa está para explodir. Como vai colocar vidro aí dentro? Esvazie umas coisas!

keys: %d bottles. Try not to break them!
en: %d bottles. Try not to break them!
pt_BR: %d garrafas. Tente não quebrar!

keys: One bottle. Don't go and break it now!
en: One bottle. Don't go and break it now!
pt_BR: Uma garrafa. Não vá quebrar agora!

keys: A deep blue wax seal stamped with the Artis crest. This is the one.
en: A deep blue wax seal stamped with the Artis crest. This is the one.
pt_BR: Um selo de cera azul-escuro com o brasão de Artis. É este.

keys: Inside, sacks of fine milled flour, just as Riskim described.
en: Inside, sacks of fine milled flour, just as Riskim described.
pt_BR: Lá dentro, sacos de farinha fina moída, exatamente como o Riskim descreveu.

keys: But your bag is too full to carry them.
en: But your bag is too full to carry them.
pt_BR: Mas sua bolsa está cheia demais para carregá-los.

keys: You're the new one Ekinu took on? Good.
en: You're the new one Ekinu took on? Good.
pt_BR: Você é o novato que o Ekinu aceitou? Bom.

keys: I guess you have many questions before going out, what can I help you with?
en: I guess you have many questions before going out, what can I help you with?
pt_BR: Imagino que você tenha muitas perguntas antes de sair. Em que posso ajudar?

keys: Stand clear of the gate. Move along.
en: Stand clear of the gate. Move along.
pt_BR: Afaste-se do portão. Siga em frente.

keys: Completing an objective, fighting or taking part in activities will help you grow. Look around and don't be afraid to talk to people around you nor to explore surrounding areas.
en: Completing an objective, fighting or taking part in activities will help you grow. Look around and don't be afraid to talk to people around you nor to explore surrounding areas.
pt_BR: Completar objetivos, lutar e participar de atividades ajudará você a crescer. Olhe ao redor e não tenha medo de falar com as pessoas nem de explorar as áreas vizinhas.

keys: You will need every edge you can get to defeat what you will face in the desert.
en: You will need every edge you can get to defeat what you will face in the desert.
pt_BR: Você precisará de toda vantagem que puder conseguir para vencer o que enfrentará no deserto.

keys: Your map is your friend, do not hesitate to use it to know where you have to go.
en: Your map is your friend, do not hesitate to use it to know where you have to go.
pt_BR: Seu mapa é seu amigo; não hesite em usá-lo para saber para onde ir.

keys: Keep your favorite objects, potions or even skills nearby, they may be useful during the sandstorm.
en: Keep your favorite objects, potions or even skills nearby, they may be useful during the sandstorm.
pt_BR: Mantenha seus objetos favoritos, poções ou até habilidades por perto; podem ser úteis durante a tempestade de areia.

keys: Welcome, welcome! Are you here for a game of cards?
en: Welcome, welcome! Are you here for a game of cards?
pt_BR: Bem-vindo, bem-vindo! Veio para uma partida de cartas?

keys: Do you know a game called blackjack? I happen to be the inventor of it!
en: Do you know a game called blackjack? I happen to be the inventor of it!
pt_BR: Conhece um jogo chamado blackjack? Acontece que fui eu que inventei!

keys: Sit down, sit down. Show me what you can do. The cards are waiting.
en: Sit down, sit down. Show me what you can do. The cards are waiting.
pt_BR: Sente-se, sente-se. Mostre o que você sabe fazer. As cartas estão esperando.

keys: The rules are simple. I should know, I made them!
en: The rules are simple. I should know, I made them!
pt_BR: As regras são simples. Eu deveria saber; fui eu que as fiz!

keys: Get as close to 21 as you can without going over.
en: Get as close to 21 as you can without going over.
pt_BR: Chegue o mais perto de 21 sem estourar.

keys: Number cards are face value, face cards are 10, and Aces... Well, Aces are tricky. They can be 1 or 11. Whatever suits you best.
en: Number cards are face value, face cards are 10, and Aces... Well, Aces are tricky. They can be 1 or 11. Whatever suits you best.
pt_BR: Cartas numeradas valem o número, figuras valem 10, e os Ases... bem, Ases são traiçoeiros. Podem ser 1 ou 11. O que te servir melhor.

keys: Beat me, and I'll tip my hat. Go over 21, and you bust. That's the game.
en: Beat me, and I'll tip my hat. Go over 21, and you bust. That's the game.
pt_BR: Vença e tirarei o chapéu para você. Passe de 21 e estourou. Esse é o jogo.

keys: Even the guards could learn this one, and that's saying something.
en: Even the guards could learn this one, and that's saying something.
pt_BR: Até os guardas aprenderiam essa, e isso sim é dizer algo.

keys: Your hand: %s
en: Your hand: %s
pt_BR: Sua mão: %s

keys: And I'm showing: %s.
en: And I'm showing: %s.
pt_BR: E eu mostro: %s.

keys: Oho, bust! Greed will do that to you. I've seen it a thousand times.
en: Oho, bust! Greed will do that to you. I've seen it a thousand times.
pt_BR: Oho, estourou! Ganância faz isso. Já vi mil vezes.

keys: My hand: %s
en: My hand: %s
pt_BR: Minha mão: %s

keys: Bah! Even an old master overreaches sometimes. Well played.
en: Bah! Even an old master overreaches sometimes. Well played.
pt_BR: Bah! Até um velho mestre se excede às vezes. Bem jogado.

keys: Heh... Not bad.
en: Heh... Not bad.
pt_BR: Heh... Nada mal.

keys: Experience wins again. Don't feel bad, most people lose to me.
en: Experience wins again. Don't feel bad, most people lose to me.
pt_BR: A experiência vence de novo. Não se sinta mal, a maioria perde para mim.

keys: A tie at %d! You've got guts, I'll give you that.
en: A tie at %d! You've got guts, I'll give you that.
pt_BR: Empate em %d! Você tem coragem, reconheço.

keys: Alright, let's see who else is brave enough. Hang tight.
en: Alright, let's see who else is brave enough. Hang tight.
pt_BR: Muito bem, vamos ver quem mais tem coragem. Aguente firme.

keys: Patience... A good card player learns to wait.
en: Patience... A good card player learns to wait.
pt_BR: Paciência... Um bom jogador aprende a esperar.

keys: Ha! We've got a match! Let's see what you're both made of.
en: Ha! We've got a match! Let's see what you're both made of.
pt_BR: Ha! Temos um confronto! Vamos ver do que vocês dois são feitos.

keys: Blackjack!
en: Blackjack!
pt_BR: Blackjack!

keys: Bust! Should've listened to your gut.
en: Bust! Should've listened to your gut.
pt_BR: Estourou! Deveria ter escutado seu instinto.

keys: Your part's done. Now we wait for your opponent...
en: Your part's done. Now we wait for your opponent...
pt_BR: Sua parte está feita. Agora esperamos seu oponente...

keys: Still thinking... Good players take their time!
en: Still thinking... Good players take their time!
pt_BR: Ainda pensando... Bons jogadores levam seu tempo!

keys: Your score: %d%s
en: Your score: %d%s
pt_BR: Sua pontuação: %d%s

keys: Opponent's hand: %s%s
en: Opponent's hand: %s%s
pt_BR: Mão do oponente: %s%s

keys: A draw! Evenly matched. That doesn't happen often at my table.
en: A draw! Evenly matched. That doesn't happen often at my table.
pt_BR: Empate! Forças iguais. Isso não acontece com frequência na minha mesa.

keys: Victory is yours! Well done, the cards favoured you today.
en: Victory is yours! Well done, the cards favoured you today.
pt_BR: A vitória é sua! Muito bem, as cartas lhe favoreceram hoje.

keys: Tough break. The cards are fickle, but they always come back around.
en: Tough break. The cards are fickle, but they always come back around.
pt_BR: Azar. As cartas são volúveis, mas sempre voltam a sorrir.

keys: Walking away mid-game? In my day, that'd cost you a round of drinks.
en: Walking away mid-game? In my day, that'd cost you a round of drinks.
pt_BR: Saindo no meio da partida? No meu tempo, isso custava uma rodada de bebidas.

keys: Hello, are you the one they pulled off the sand? Glad to see you walking about. I need your help.
en: Hello, are you the one they pulled off the sand? Glad to see you walking about. I need your help.
pt_BR: Olá, você é aquele que tiraram da areia? Que bom te ver andando por aí. Preciso da sua ajuda.

keys: The maggots love feeding on the cactus. Even though these maggots are unusually large, their mouths are still small and agile enough to eat their way around any spikes.
en: The maggots love feeding on the cactus. Even though these maggots are unusually large, their mouths are still small and agile enough to eat their way around any spikes.
pt_BR: As larvas adoram se alimentar dos cactus. Mesmo sendo invulgarmente grandes, suas bocas ainda são pequenas e ágeis o suficiente para comer por entre qualquer espinho.

keys: Once they breach the outside they simply burrow into the plant and eat it from the inside. It's a horrible sight.
en: Once they breach the outside they simply burrow into the plant and eat it from the inside. It's a horrible sight.
pt_BR: Quando furam por fora, simplesmente se enterram na planta e a comem por dentro. É horrível de ver.

keys: They say they weren't always like this. I'm not old enough to remember, no one is anymore.
en: They say they weren't always like this. I'm not old enough to remember, no one is anymore.
pt_BR: Dizem que nem sempre foram assim. Não sou velho o bastante para lembrar; ninguém mais é.

keys: Back before the Age of Kaore, hundreds of years ago, some creatures of this world were not as... Strange as they are today.
en: Back before the Age of Kaore, hundreds of years ago, some creatures of this world were not as... Strange as they are today.
pt_BR: Antes da Era da Kaore, há centenas de anos, algumas criaturas deste mundo não eram tão... Estranhas quanto são hoje.

keys: The Age of Kaore changed them. This type of maggot grew very large and very plentiful. Other creatures were changed in worse ways.
en: The Age of Kaore changed them. This type of maggot grew very large and very plentiful. Other creatures were changed in worse ways.
pt_BR: A Era da Kaore as mudou. Este tipo de larva cresceu muito e se multiplicou bastante. Outras criaturas mudaram de formas piores.

keys: They say that squirrels used to be as intelligent as people, but they simply lost all that over time.
en: They say that squirrels used to be as intelligent as people, but they simply lost all that over time.
pt_BR: Dizem que os esquilos já foram tão inteligentes quanto pessoas, mas simplesmente perderam tudo isso com o tempo.

keys: Anyway, enough chatting. I need you to get in this field and clean away this mess!
en: Anyway, enough chatting. I need you to get in this field and clean away this mess!
pt_BR: Enfim, chega de conversa. Preciso que você entre nesta plantação e limpe esta bagunça!

keys: Regardless, they need to be culled.
en: Regardless, they need to be culled.
pt_BR: De qualquer forma, precisam ser eliminados.

keys: Whatever has been happening out in the desert has affected the maggots of the city as well.
en: Whatever has been happening out in the desert has affected the maggots of the city as well.
pt_BR: Seja lá o que esteja acontecendo lá fora no deserto, também afetou as larvas da cidade.

keys: Even worse, it seems cacti are also affected.
en: Even worse, it seems cacti are also affected.
pt_BR: Pior ainda: parece que os cactus também são afetados.

keys: Some of them are jumping around and doing silly faces while splashing nearby crops! You need to help me deal with this.
en: Some of them are jumping around and doing silly faces while splashing nearby crops! You need to help me deal with this.
pt_BR: Algumas ficam pulando e fazendo caretas engraçadas enquanto espirram água nas plantações! Você precisa me ajudar com isso.

keys: Kaore is affecting all sorts of creatures.
en: Kaore is affecting all sorts of creatures.
pt_BR: Kaore está afetando todo tipo de criatura.

keys: It's this evil force that twists living things into... I don't know... Worse versions of themselves? I suppose. More aggressive.
en: It's this evil force that twists living things into... I don't know... Worse versions of themselves? I suppose. More aggressive.
pt_BR: É esta força maligna que distorce os seres vivos em... não sei... versões piores de si mesmos? Suponho. Mais agressivas.

keys: Until it takes a full hold on them, then they become sort of undead too. It's really a nasty curse.
en: Until it takes a full hold on them, then they become sort of undead too. It's really a nasty curse.
pt_BR: Até que tome pleno controle delas; aí também viram uma espécie de mortas-vivas. É uma maldição horrível.

keys: The mages over at the tower... The Manayir. They've issued the warning that Kaore is currently concentrating in dangerous patterns throughout Tonori.
en: The mages over at the tower... The Manayir. They've issued the warning that Kaore is currently concentrating in dangerous patterns throughout Tonori.
pt_BR: Os magos lá da torre... os Manayir. Emitiram o aviso de que Kaore está se concentrando em padrões perigosos por todo Tonori.

keys: They're some ancient order that studies Mana and does who-knows-what-else with it, up in that tower to the west of the city.
en: They're some ancient order that studies Mana and does who-knows-what-else with it, up in that tower to the west of the city.
pt_BR: São alguma ordem antiga que estuda Mana e faz quem-sabe-o-quê com ela, naquela torre a oeste da cidade.

keys: They're the ones who issue warnings about Kaore.
en: They're the ones who issue warnings about Kaore.
pt_BR: São eles que emitem os avisos sobre Kaore.

keys: The Manayir Order are the ones who announced the end of the Age of Kaore about 27 years ago.
en: The Manayir Order are the ones who announced the end of the Age of Kaore about 27 years ago.
pt_BR: Foi a Ordem Manayir que anunciou o fim da Era da Kaore há cerca de 27 anos.

keys: Ever since then they've been updating the people of Tulimshar about the flow of energies.
en: Ever since then they've been updating the people of Tulimshar about the flow of energies.
pt_BR: Desde então, eles mantêm o povo de Tulimshar informado sobre o fluxo das energias.

keys: It's much like weather, different concentrations of Mana and Kaore are everchanging and can affect all living things in the area.
en: It's much like weather, different concentrations of Mana and Kaore are everchanging and can affect all living things in the area.
pt_BR: É como o clima: concentrações diferentes de Mana e Kaore mudam o tempo todo e podem afetar todos os seres vivos da área.

keys: I'm too young to remember, but until a few decades ago life was much more difficult for everyone.
en: I'm too young to remember, but until a few decades ago life was much more difficult for everyone.
pt_BR: Sou novo demais para lembrar, mas até algumas décadas atrás a vida era muito mais difícil para todo mundo.

keys: Kaore had become more plentiful than Mana and for a few hundred years people struggled a lot more than today with mutated and even undead creatures.
en: Kaore had become more plentiful than Mana and for a few hundred years people struggled a lot more than today with mutated and even undead creatures.
pt_BR: A Kaore se tornou mais abundante que Mana e, por uns séculos, as pessoas lutaram muito mais do que hoje contra criaturas mutadas e até mortas-vivas.

keys: We complain about maggots and peyotes, but really we have it easy compared to what my parents lived through.
en: We complain about maggots and peyotes, but really we have it easy compared to what my parents lived through.
pt_BR: Reclamamos de larvas e peyotes, mas na verdade temos vida fácil comparada ao que meus pais passaram.

keys: Start with the peyotes in that field just north from here.
en: Start with the peyotes in that field just north from here.
pt_BR: Comece com os peyotes naquela plantação logo ao norte daqui.

keys: They're kaore-infused cacti, harmless to us but useless for farming now.
en: They're kaore-infused cacti, harmless to us but useless for farming now.
pt_BR: São cactus infundidos de kaore, inofensivos para nós, mas inúteis para o cultivo agora.

keys: They just taunt people by jumping around and splashing crops near them...
en: They just taunt people by jumping around and splashing crops near them...
pt_BR: Só provocam as pessoas pulando e espirrando água nas plantações perto delas...

keys: Getting rid of 5 peyotes and 5 maggots should suffice to keep our crops safe for the day.
en: Getting rid of 5 peyotes and 5 maggots should suffice to keep our crops safe for the day.
pt_BR: Se livrar de 5 peyotes e 5 larvas deve bastar para manter nossas plantações seguras pelo resto do dia.

keys: Not done yet. I still need you to clear out %d more peyote from the field.
en: Not done yet. I still need you to clear out %d more peyote from the field.
pt_BR: Ainda não terminei. Ainda preciso que você limpe %d peyotes a mais da plantação.

keys: Good work on the peyotes. Still need you to deal with %d more maggots though.
en: Good work on the peyotes. Still need you to deal with %d more maggots though.
pt_BR: Bom trabalho com os peyotes. Mas ainda preciso que você cuide de %d larvas.

keys: Impressive work!
en: Impressive work!
pt_BR: Trabalho impressionante!

keys: You took care of that very quickly and way better than I expected.
en: You took care of that very quickly and way better than I expected.
pt_BR: Você cuidou disso bem rápido e muito melhor do que eu esperava.

keys: You should report to Watchman Ekinu, near the gate where you met Elanore. Tell him I was happy with your work here.
en: You should report to Watchman Ekinu, near the gate where you met Elanore. Tell him I was happy with your work here.
pt_BR: Reporte-se ao Vigia Ekinu, perto do portão onde conheceu a Elanore. Diga a ele que fiquei satisfeito com seu trabalho aqui.

keys: We're going on a small expedition into the desert soon and you might be the right type of person to help us out.
en: We're going on a small expedition into the desert soon and you might be the right type of person to help us out.
pt_BR: Vamos fazer uma pequena expedição ao deserto em breve, e você pode ser a pessoa certa para nos ajudar.

keys: Report back to Watchman Ekinu when you're ready.
en: Report back to Watchman Ekinu when you're ready.
pt_BR: Reporte-se ao Vigia Ekinu quando estiver pronto.

keys: He'll know what to do next.
en: He'll know what to do next.
pt_BR: Ele saberá o que fazer em seguida.

keys: Glad to see you! As you can see, I'm still surrounded by these squirky white maggots.
en: Glad to see you! As you can see, I'm still surrounded by these squirky white maggots.
pt_BR: Que bom te ver! Como pode ver, continuo cercado por estas larvas brancas esquisitas.

keys: Aim, shoot and block your ears as they do some nasty sounds when you hit them.
en: Aim, shoot and block your ears as they do some nasty sounds when you hit them.
pt_BR: Mire, atire e tape os ouvidos, pois eles fazem uns sons horríveis quando você acerta.

keys: You find two old envelopes tucked between the dusty books.
en: You find two old envelopes tucked between the dusty books.
pt_BR: Você encontra dois envelopes velhos escondidos entre os livros empoeirados.

keys: One is sealed with care, the other feels surprisingly heavy.
en: One is sealed with care, the other feels surprisingly heavy.
pt_BR: Uma está selada com cuidado; a outra parece surpreendentemente pesada.

keys: You spot the envelopes, but your bag is too full to carry them.
en: You spot the envelopes, but your bag is too full to carry them.
pt_BR: Você avista os envelopes, mas sua bolsa está cheia demais para carregá-los.

keys: Oh, a new face! Welcome to Tulimshar.
en: Oh, a new face! Welcome to Tulimshar.
pt_BR: Oh, uma cara nova! Bem-vindo a Tulimshar.

keys: I'm %s. I help people find their footing around here.
en: I'm %s. I help people find their footing around here.
pt_BR: Eu sou %s. Ajudou as pessoas a se encontrarem por aqui.

keys: Need to know where something is? Ask away.
en: Need to know where something is? Ask away.
pt_BR: Precisa saber onde fica algo? Pode perguntar.

keys: Tulimshar sits in the valley that lies between our eastern and western hills.
en: Tulimshar sits in the valley that lies between our eastern and western hills.
pt_BR: Tulimshar está sentada no vale entre as colinas leste e oeste.

keys: The wall you see around us keeps the desert out from wildness and protects us from that southern sandstorm.
en: The wall you see around us keeps the desert out from wildness and protects us from that southern sandstorm.
pt_BR: A muralha que vemos ao nosso redor mantém o deserto selvagem longe e nos protege daquela tempestade de areia ao sul.

keys: We mostly stay within that area, most people live and work in the central district which spreads between here and the port to the north.
en: We mostly stay within that area, most people live and work in the central district which spreads between here and the port to the north.
pt_BR: Ficamos quase sempre naquela área; a maioria das pessoas vive e trabalha no distrito central, que se estende daqui até o porto, ao norte.

keys: That northern part is your best bet for anything you could need, markets, games, the lot.
en: That northern part is your best bet for anything you could need, markets, games, the lot.
pt_BR: Aquela parte ao norte é sua melhor opção para tudo que precisar: mercados, jogos, etc.

keys: The community is very close-knit.
en: The community is very close-knit.
pt_BR: A comunidade é muito unida.

keys: We try to help each other and it's great to have people who care about each other's interests.
en: We try to help each other and it's great to have people who care about each other's interests.
pt_BR: Tentamos nos ajudar mutuamente, e é ótimo ter pessoas que se importam umas com as outras.

keys: Be warned: insults are not welcomed here, just so you know. We look after each other in this city.
en: Be warned: insults are not welcomed here, just so you know. We look after each other in this city.
pt_BR: Aviso: insultos não são bem-vindos aqui, só para você saber. Nesta cidade, cuidamos uns dos outros.

keys: Welcome aboard, or close enough.
en: Welcome aboard, or close enough.
pt_BR: Bem-vindo a bordo, ou quase isso.

keys: I'm the captain of La Johanne, the vessel docked right behind me.
en: I'm the captain of La Johanne, the vessel docked right behind me.
pt_BR: Sou o capitão do La Johanne, o navio ancorado logo atrás de mim.

keys: We are currently enjoying a well earned break far from cold weathers, as we've spent the last few weeks up north in the Kaizei region.
en: We are currently enjoying a well earned break far from cold weathers, as we've spent the last few weeks up north in the Kaizei region.
pt_BR: Estamos aproveitando um merecido descanso longe do frio, pois passamos as últimas semanas ao norte, na região de Kaizei.

keys: We are sailing towards Candor soon, but in the meantime we can go for a short trip wherever you want.
en: We are sailing towards Candor soon, but in the meantime we can go for a short trip wherever you want.
pt_BR: Estamos de partida para Candor em breve, mas enquanto isso podemos fazer um passeio curto para onde você quiser.

keys: Our ship is sturdy and fast. We've travelled almost every shore on Aemil. Even as far as Thermin one time!
en: Our ship is sturdy and fast. We've travelled almost every shore on Aemil. Even as far as Thermin one time!
pt_BR: Nosso navio é resistente e rápido. Já navegamos quase toda a costa de Aemil. Uma vez até Thermin!

keys: When you're ready to go, head to La Johanne's helm. There we can discuss where exactly you want to go.
en: When you're ready to go, head to La Johanne's helm. There we can discuss where exactly you want to go.
pt_BR: Quando estiver pronto para partir, vá ao leme do La Johanne. Lá poderemos discutir exatamente para onde você quer ir.

keys: It's been a while since I've ferried someone out to sea. We usually handle cargo, not people.
en: It's been a while since I've ferried someone out to sea. We usually handle cargo, not people.
pt_BR: Faz tempo que não levo alguém para o mar. Normalmente cuidamos de carga, não de pessoas.

keys: Candor to the north, the Manayir coast west from here, or all the way to Artis on the north-east.
en: Candor to the north, the Manayir coast west from here, or all the way to Artis on the north-east.
pt_BR: Candor ao norte, a costa de Manayir a oeste daqui, ou Artis lá no nordeste.

keys: For any other destination we'd need to prepare for a little longer.
en: For any other destination we'd need to prepare for a little longer.
pt_BR: Para qualquer outro destino precisaríamos nos preparar um pouco mais.

keys: I wouldn't want to be paying Esperia's harbour fees without good reason! Or Hurnscald for that matter.
en: I wouldn't want to be paying Esperia's harbour fees without good reason! Or Hurnscald for that matter.
pt_BR: Não gostaria de estar pagando as taxas do porto de Esperia sem um bom motivo! Nem as de Hurnscald, já que estamos falando nisso.

keys: I started out as carpenter in the port of Artis. I didn't have much at the time, but I was good at my job.
en: I started out as carpenter in the port of Artis. I didn't have much at the time, but I was good at my job.
pt_BR: Comecei como carpinteiro no porto de Artis. Eu não tinha muita coisa na época, mas era bom no que fazia.

keys: I even taught some students at one point.
en: I even taught some students at one point.
pt_BR: Cheguei até a dar aulas a alguns alunos.

keys: Eventually I made enough to buy my own ship. It was almost a wreck, but I worked on it day and night until it was ready to sail again.
en: Eventually I made enough to buy my own ship. It was almost a wreck, but I worked on it day and night until it was ready to sail again.
pt_BR: No fim juntei o suficiente para comprar meu próprio navio. Era quase um casco, mas trabalhei nele dia e noite até estar pronto para navegar de novo.

keys: I got some friends together: Gado, Julia and my old pal Magic Arpan. We had all worked together before at the port.
en: I got some friends together: Gado, Julia and my old pal Magic Arpan. We had all worked together before at the port.
pt_BR: Reuni alguns amigos: o Gado, a Julia e meu velho parceiro Magic Arpan. Todos já tínhamos trabalhado juntos no porto.

keys: We named our ship La Johanne. After its previous captain. I know you're not supposed to rename a ship, but I did almost rebuild it after all.
en: We named our ship La Johanne. After its previous captain. I know you're not supposed to rename a ship, but I did almost rebuild it after all.
pt_BR: Batizamos nosso navio de La Johanne. Em homenagem à capitã anterior. Sei que não se deve renomear um navio, mas afinal eu quase o reconstruí inteiro.

keys: Now we make our living going from coast to coast, ferrying goods back and forth. For a fair price too, I'd say.
en: Now we make our living going from coast to coast, ferrying goods back and forth. For a fair price too, I'd say.
pt_BR: Agora ganhamos a vida indo de costa a costa, levando mercadorias de um lado para o outro. Por um preço justo, eu diria.

keys: The greatest city in the world, if you ask me. The atmosphere, the people, the wine...
en: The greatest city in the world, if you ask me. The atmosphere, the people, the wine...
pt_BR: A maior cidade do mundo, no meu ver. O clima, o povo, o vinho...

keys: I do miss it, but we get to go back often, even if it's not for long. Lots of goods come in and out of Artis.
en: I do miss it, but we get to go back often, even if it's not for long. Lots of goods come in and out of Artis.
pt_BR: Sinto falta, sim, mas voltamos com frequência, mesmo que por pouco tempo. Muita mercadoria entra e sai de Artis.

keys: I miss my students though. Maybe one day I'll go back to teaching. Who knows?
en: I miss my students though. Maybe one day I'll go back to teaching. Who knows?
pt_BR: Mas sinto falta dos meus alunos. Talvez um dia eu volte a dar aulas. Quem sabe?

keys: I had known some of them for a long time. Gado was my first mate for a time.  Julia was my cook.
en: I had known some of them for a long time. Gado was my first mate for a time.  Julia was my cook.
pt_BR: Já conhecia alguns havia muito tempo. O Gado foi meu imediato por um tempo. A Julia era minha cozinheira.

keys: Problem was, Gado likes to argue and he's a great cook. Julia likes her peace... and she's terrible in the kitchen! So, I swapped them around.
en: Problem was, Gado likes to argue and he's a great cook. Julia likes her peace... and she's terrible in the kitchen! So, I swapped them around.
pt_BR: O problema é que o Gado gosta de discutir e é um ótimo cozinheiro. A Julia gosta de paz... e é péssima na cozinha! Então eu os troquei de função.

keys: Magic Arpan... how could I not have him on board? We've been good friends for years. He's a charming guy. Literally, he can charm you with magic!
en: Magic Arpan... how could I not have him on board? We've been good friends for years. He's a charming guy. Literally, he can charm you with magic!
pt_BR: Magic Arpan... como eu poderia não tê-lo a bordo? Somos bons amigos há anos. Um cara encantador. Literalmente; ele pode te encantar com magia!

keys: All the others I picked up over time. People whose attitude I like. Everyone on board is with me for a reason.
en: All the others I picked up over time. People whose attitude I like. Everyone on board is with me for a reason.
pt_BR: Todos os outros fui recolhendo com o tempo. Gente de quem gosto do jeito de ser. Todo mundo a bordo está comigo por um motivo.

keys: They're all useful and important... except maybe for Silvio. He's just here to drink and flirt with Julia, that old drunk!
en: They're all useful and important... except maybe for Silvio. He's just here to drink and flirt with Julia, that old drunk!
pt_BR: Todos são úteis e importantes... exceto talvez o Silvio. Ele só está aqui para beber e flertar com a Julia, seu bêbado velho!

keys: Hello again.
en: Hello again.
pt_BR: Olá de novo.

keys: Hello. Elanore sent you? Welcome.
en: Hello. Elanore sent you? Welcome.
pt_BR: Olá. A Elanore mandou você? Seja bem-vindo.

keys: We are standing before Tulimshar's ancient Soul Menhir. I am its guardian and use its powers to protect the people of this city, or as much as I am allowed to.
en: We are standing before Tulimshar's ancient Soul Menhir. I am its guardian and use its powers to protect the people of this city, or as much as I am allowed to.
pt_BR: Estamos diante do antigo Soul Menhir de Tulimshar. Sou seu guardião e uso seus poderes para proteger o povo desta cidade, ou tanto quanto me é permitido.

keys: Not exactly. Kahwes, or Druids, have always been allowed in Tulimshar. If anything because without us the city would not survive the worst droughts and other perils of Tonori's climate.
en: Not exactly. Kahwes, or Druids, have always been allowed in Tulimshar. If anything because without us the city would not survive the worst droughts and other perils of Tonori's climate.
pt_BR: Não exatamente. Kahwes, ou Druidas, sempre foram bem-vindos em Tulimshar. Se não fosse por nós, a cidade não sobreviveria às piores secas e outros perigos do clima de Tonori.

keys: The Kingdom however officially follows the Savean Creed. They believe, like half of the people around you, that Mana is also a corrupting force just like Kaore and that both should be avoided unless strictly necessary.
en: The Kingdom however officially follows the Savean Creed. They believe, like half of the people around you, that Mana is also a corrupting force just like Kaore and that both should be avoided unless strictly necessary.
pt_BR: O Reino, porém, segue oficialmente o Credo Savean. Acreditam, como metade das pessoas ao seu redor, que Mana é também uma força corruptora, assim como Kaore, e que ambas devem ser evitadas, a menos que estritamente necessário.

keys: Our Menhir still stands because it makes people's lives easier. Even those who have opposing beliefs cannot deny the benefit of Mana use. They will oppose it publicly, but when a personal need arises, they will seek Kahwes like myself to heal a loved one or bring some needed rain.
en: Our Menhir still stands because it makes people's lives easier. Even those who have opposing beliefs cannot deny the benefit of Mana use. They will oppose it publicly, but when a personal need arises, they will seek Kahwes like myself to heal a loved one or bring some needed rain.
pt_BR: Nosso Menhir continua de pé porque facilita a vida das pessoas. Até quem tem crenças opostas não nega o benefício de usar Mana. Vão se opor publicamente, mas quando surge uma necessidade pessoal, procuram Kahwes como eu para curar um ente querido ou trazer chuva.

keys: I just wish that more people embraced the ancient traditions more openly. The Savean beliefs have brought much trouble to our world. Now they have even spawned these new cultists, the Varunian, who essentially worship Kaore.
en: I just wish that more people embraced the ancient traditions more openly. The Savean beliefs have brought much trouble to our world. Now they have even spawned these new cultists, the Varunian, who essentially worship Kaore.
pt_BR: Só queria que mais pessoas abraçassem as tradições antigas com mais abertura. As crenças Savean trouxeram muitos problemas ao nosso mundo. Agora até geraram estes novos cultistas, os Varunianos, que basicamente adoram Kaore.

keys: None of this is how the relationship with Mana has been for most of Aemil's existence.
en: None of this is how the relationship with Mana has been for most of Aemil's existence.
pt_BR: Nada disso é como a relação com Mana foi pela maior parte da existência de Aemil.

keys: The Kahwe carry on the knowledge of times when Mana was a harmonious force of good in our world. We seek to restore the balance that was lost when the Uru were destroyed.
en: The Kahwe carry on the knowledge of times when Mana was a harmonious force of good in our world. We seek to restore the balance that was lost when the Uru were destroyed.
pt_BR: Os Kahwe mantêm o conhecimento de tempos em que Mana era uma força harmoniosa e boa em nosso mundo. Buscamos restaurar o equilíbrio perdido quando os Uru foram destruídos.

keys: Uru, also known as Mana Trees, used to be the heart of the world's lifeforce, acting as a natural conductor for Mana energy.
en: Uru, also known as Mana Trees, used to be the heart of the world's lifeforce, acting as a natural conductor for Mana energy.
pt_BR: Uru, também conhecidos como Árvores de Mana, eram o coração da força vital do mundo, atuando como condutores naturais da energia de Mana.

keys: In ancient times, there were many, each serving as a stabilizing force, preventing Mana from decaying into Kaore.
en: In ancient times, there were many, each serving as a stabilizing force, preventing Mana from decaying into Kaore.
pt_BR: Na antiguidade, havia muitos, cada um servindo como força estabilizadora, impedindo Mana de decair em Kaore.

keys: The Mana Trees were destroyed many years ago after a devastating war where the Savean Creed took hold among the ruling elites of Aemil.
en: The Mana Trees were destroyed many years ago after a devastating war where the Savean Creed took hold among the ruling elites of Aemil.
pt_BR: As Árvores de Mana foram destruídas há muitos anos, depois de uma guerra devastadora na qual o Credo Savean tomou conta das elites governantes de Aemil.

keys: The decision was made to destroy the Uru and attempt to create a world without Mana.
en: The decision was made to destroy the Uru and attempt to create a world without Mana.
pt_BR: Decidiu-se destruir os Uru e tentar criar um mundo sem Mana.

keys: It depends on who you ask. Some people, like the Red Queen, would say that life is better without magic.
en: It depends on who you ask. Some people, like the Red Queen, would say that life is better without magic.
pt_BR: Depende de com quem você fala. Algumas pessoas, como a Rainha Vermelha, diriam que a vida é melhor sem magia.

keys: But then, she still uses it in her palace. She only means that it's better for the common people to not have it, claims that it's too dangerous.
en: But then, she still uses it in her palace. She only means that it's better for the common people to not have it, claims that it's too dangerous.
pt_BR: Mas ainda assim, ela mesma a usa no palácio. Ela só quer dizer que é melhor para o povo comum não tê-la, alegando que é perigosa demais.

keys: If you ask me, I believe that magic is a natural part of our world. It has led us to where we are today, and despite being the most dangerous force of nature, we need it.
en: If you ask me, I believe that magic is a natural part of our world. It has led us to where we are today, and despite being the most dangerous force of nature, we need it.
pt_BR: No meu ver, a magia é parte natural do nosso mundo. Foi ela que nos trouxe até aqui e, apesar de ser a força mais perigosa da natureza, nós a precisamos.

keys: Water is a dangerous force of nature too if you think about it, but no one is suggesting to close the wells.
en: Water is a dangerous force of nature too if you think about it, but no one is suggesting to close the wells.
pt_BR: A água também é uma força perigosa da natureza, se pensar bem, mas ninguém está sugerindo fechar os poços.

keys: She's the ruler of our city and the whole Kingdom of Tonori, though she doesn't have much power outside of the city walls.
en: She's the ruler of our city and the whole Kingdom of Tonori, though she doesn't have much power outside of the city walls.
pt_BR: Ela é a governante da nossa cidade e de todo o Reino de Tonori, embora não tenha muito poder fora das muralhas.

keys: The Zuni tribes of Tonori never recognised our Kingdom so she really only rules over the city.
en: The Zuni tribes of Tonori never recognised our Kingdom so she really only rules over the city.
pt_BR: As tribos Zuni de Tonori nunca reconheceram nosso Reino, então ela reina mesmo só sobre a cidade.

keys: Another reason for her to keep magic away from her people. The Zuni still practice their ancient magic and it makes them very hard to fight.
en: Another reason for her to keep magic away from her people. The Zuni still practice their ancient magic and it makes them very hard to fight.
pt_BR: Mais um motivo para ela manter a magia longe do povo. Os Zuni ainda praticam sua magia antiga, e isso os torna muito difíceis de combater.

keys: She'd rather not have the same problem here in Tulimshar.
en: She'd rather not have the same problem here in Tulimshar.
pt_BR: Ela preferiria não ter o mesmo problema aqui em Tulimshar.

keys: They have lived in the Tonori desert for a very long time. In fact, they still tell stories of this land before it was even a desert.
en: They have lived in the Tonori desert for a very long time. In fact, they still tell stories of this land before it was even a desert.
pt_BR: Vivem no deserto de Tonori há muito tempo. Na verdade, ainda contam histórias destas terras antes mesmo de serem um deserto.

keys: They've always traded with Tulimshar and are mostly friendly towards us, but only as long as we don't send our soldiers too far outside our walls.
en: They've always traded with Tulimshar and are mostly friendly towards us, but only as long as we don't send our soldiers too far outside our walls.
pt_BR: Sempre comerciaram com Tulimshar e são majoritariamente amigáveis conosco, mas só enquanto não mandarmos nossos soldados longe demais das muralhas.

keys: Whenever that has happened in the past they've fought us back until we gave up. I respect that about them, they have clear boundaries and will defend their homeland.
en: Whenever that has happened in the past they've fought us back until we gave up. I respect that about them, they have clear boundaries and will defend their homeland.
pt_BR: Sempre que isso aconteceu no passado, eles nos repeliram até desistirmos. Respeito isso neles; têm fronteiras claras e defendem sua terra.

keys: Right...
en: Right...
pt_BR: Certo...

keys: You can find some of their traders in the marketplace north of here.
en: You can find some of their traders in the marketplace north of here.
pt_BR: Você encontra alguns de seus comerciantes no mercado ao norte daqui.

keys: I'm sure they'll be happy to chat, especially if you buy some of their wares.
en: I'm sure they'll be happy to chat, especially if you buy some of their wares.
pt_BR: Tenho certeza de que ficarão felizes em conversar, principalmente se você comprar alguma de suas mercadorias.

keys: Mana, often called "lifepower," is the essence of all living things.
en: Mana, often called "lifepower," is the essence of all living things.
pt_BR: Mana, muitas vezes chamada de “força vital”, é a essência de todos os seres vivos.

keys: It flows through the world's biomass, forming an interconnected web of energy. Properly channelled, it can be harnessed to produce magic, heal the land, and sustain life.
en: It flows through the world's biomass, forming an interconnected web of energy. Properly channelled, it can be harnessed to produce magic, heal the land, and sustain life.
pt_BR: Ela flui pela biomassa do mundo, formando uma rede interligada de energia.

keys: Kaore is what remains when Mana is severed from its source.
en: Kaore is what remains when Mana is severed from its source.
pt_BR: Kaore é o que resta quando Mana é separada de sua fonte.

keys: Instead of nourishing life, it festers, corrupts, and decays. It seeps into the land, warping living beings into hostile, aggressive forms.
en: Instead of nourishing life, it festers, corrupts, and decays. It seeps into the land, warping living beings into hostile, aggressive forms.
pt_BR: Em vez de nutrir a vida, ela infecciona, corrompe e decai. Encharca a terra e deforma os seres vivos em formas hostis e agressivas.

keys: Kaore in many ways is a form of Mana, which is the main energy we can perceive.
en: Kaore in many ways is a form of Mana, which is the main energy we can perceive.
pt_BR: Kaore é, de muitas formas, uma espécie de Mana, a principal energia que podemos perceber.

keys: Mana flows through all living things, but also infuses a particular mineral known as Zielite. That's what this Soul Menhir is made of.
en: Mana flows through all living things, but also infuses a particular mineral known as Zielite. That's what this Soul Menhir is made of.
pt_BR: Mana flui por todos os seres vivos, mas também infunde um mineral específico conhecido como Zielite. É disso que este Soul Menhir é feito.

keys: Soul Menhirs are ancient monoliths carved from massive blocks of Zielite, once erected by the Kahwe, known as druids around here, to channel and radiate Mana.
