en: Soul Menhirs are ancient monoliths carved from massive blocks of Zielite, once erected by the Kahwe, known as druids around here, to channel and radiate Mana.
pt_BR: Soul Menhirs são monólitos antigos esculpidos em blocos enormes de Zielite, erguidos outrora pelos Kahwe, chamados de druidas por aqui, para canalizar e irradiar Mana.

keys: When active, they generate a protective aura, repelling Kaore-infected creatures and stabilizing the land.
en: When active, they generate a protective aura, repelling Kaore-infected creatures and stabilizing the land.
pt_BR: Quando ativos, geram uma aura protetora que repele criaturas infectadas por Kaore e estabiliza a terra.

keys: With the help of a Kahwe, a Soul Menhir can be used to heal those who are injured and even to prevent death in some cases, giving people multiple chances at life.
en: With the help of a Kahwe, a Soul Menhir can be used to heal those who are injured and even to prevent death in some cases, giving people multiple chances at life.
pt_BR: Com a ajuda de um Kahwe, um Soul Menhir pode ser usado para curar feridos e até impedir a morte em alguns casos, dando às pessoas múltiplas chances de vida.

keys: Zielite is a rare mineral with a natural affinity for Mana. It can absorb, store, and emit Mana energy, making it invaluable for both magic and protection.
en: Zielite is a rare mineral with a natural affinity for Mana. It can absorb, store, and emit Mana energy, making it invaluable for both magic and protection.
pt_BR: Zielite é um mineral raro com afinidade natural por Mana. Pode absorver, armazenar e emitir energia de Mana, tornando-a inestimável tanto para magia quanto para proteção.

keys: Though once abundant, Zielite has become scarce due to the purge that took place when the Savean Creed turned society against the use of Mana.
en: Though once abundant, Zielite has become scarce due to the purge that took place when the Savean Creed turned society against the use of Mana.
pt_BR: Embora antes abundante, a Zielite se tornou rara devido à purga ocorrida quando o Credo Savean virou a sociedade contra o uso de Mana.

keys: Zielite craftsmanship still exists in hidden talismans, forgotten ruins, and the few remaining Soul Menhirs that continue to stand as bastions against Kaore.
en: Zielite craftsmanship still exists in hidden talismans, forgotten ruins, and the few remaining Soul Menhirs that continue to stand as bastions against Kaore.
pt_BR: O artesanato em Zielite ainda existe em talismãs escondidos, ruínas esquecidas e nos poucos Soul Menhirs que continuam de pé como baluartes contra Kaore.

keys: Not at the moment. I am still hoping for that snack, if you happen to find one!
en: Not at the moment. I am still hoping for that snack, if you happen to find one!
pt_BR: Por enquanto não. Ainda estou esperando por aquele lanche, caso você encontre um!

keys: Not at the moment, but thank you for asking.
en: Not at the moment, but thank you for asking.
pt_BR: Por enquanto não, mas obrigado por perguntar.

keys: Not at the moment...
en: Not at the moment...
pt_BR: Por enquanto não...

keys: I am a bit hungry though. Not that I would ask you to bring me food! I'll take care of it later.
en: I am a bit hungry though. Not that I would ask you to bring me food! I'll take care of it later.
pt_BR: Estou até com uma fome. Não que eu fosse te pedir para trazer comida! Dou um jeito depois.

keys: That is very kind of you. I would not normally ask, but a croissant would be absolutely wonderful right now.
en: That is very kind of you. I would not normally ask, but a croissant would be absolutely wonderful right now.
pt_BR: Isso é muito gentil da sua parte. Normalmente eu não pediria, mas um croissant estaria absolutamente perfeito agora.

keys: You can usually find them at the bakery stand in the market. I would go myself but, well... this Menhir will not guard itself.
en: You can usually find them at the bakery stand in the market. I would go myself but, well... this Menhir will not guard itself.
pt_BR: Normalmente você as encontra na barraca da padaria no mercado. Eu iria pessoalmente, mas, bem... este Menhir não se guarda sozinho.

keys: Oh my!
en: Oh my!
pt_BR: Oh céus!

keys: A croissant! I cannot believe it. You are truly too kind, I did not expect this at all!
en: A croissant! I cannot believe it. You are truly too kind, I did not expect this at all!
pt_BR: Um croissant! Não acredito. Você é gentil demais, eu não esperava isso de jeito nenhum!

keys: Please, take these Cactus Potions and a bit of gold to cover what you spent.
en: Please, take these Cactus Potions and a bit of gold to cover what you spent.
pt_BR: Por favor, pegue estas Cactus Potions e um pouco de ouro para cobrir o que você gastou.

keys: You're back!
en: You're back!
pt_BR: Você voltou!

keys: How was the expedition?
en: How was the expedition?
pt_BR: Como foi a expedição?

keys: May I see it?
en: May I see it?
pt_BR: Posso ver?

keys: You're right. I can't believe this. This is a Kano. A Mana Seed!
en: You're right. I can't believe this. This is a Kano. A Mana Seed!
pt_BR: Você está certo. Não posso acreditar. Isto é um Kano. Uma Semente de Mana!

keys: I have only ever read about these. I never imagined I would see one in my lifetime.
en: I have only ever read about these. I never imagined I would see one in my lifetime.
pt_BR: Só tinha lido sobre estes. Nunca imaginei que veria um em minha vida.

keys: How did you come to find this?
en: How did you come to find this?
pt_BR: Como você foi descobrir isso?

keys: Excuse me?! Did you say a Mana Tree? Alive? In the Sandstorm Mines???
en: Excuse me?! Did you say a Mana Tree? Alive? In the Sandstorm Mines???
pt_BR: Com licença?! Você disse uma Árvore de Mana? Viva? Nas Minas da Tempestade???
Eu...

keys: I need a moment.
en: I need a moment.
pt_BR: Preciso de um momento.

keys: I once felt something in that direction, a long time ago. I assumed it was a deep Zielite deposit. I had no idea.
en: I once felt something in that direction, a long time ago. I assumed it was a deep Zielite deposit. I had no idea.
pt_BR: Uma vez senti algo naquela direção, há muito tempo. Achei que fosse um depósito profundo de Zielite. Não fazia ideia.

keys: Were you able to communicate with it? Did it tell you what to do with that Kano?
en: Were you able to communicate with it? Did it tell you what to do with that Kano?
pt_BR: Você conseguiu se comunicar com ele? Ele disse o que fazer com o Kano?

keys: How does it know me? This is all... very hard to grasp.
en: How does it know me? This is all... very hard to grasp.
pt_BR: Como ele me conhece? Isso é tudo... muito difícil de compreender.

keys: I'm glad it trusted me, but we will need to let the Manayir know about this. They are an ancient order of druids who were once guardians of these trees.
en: I'm glad it trusted me, but we will need to let the Manayir know about this. They are an ancient order of druids who were once guardians of these trees.
pt_BR: Fico feliz que ele tenha confiado em mim, mas precisaremos avisar os Manayir. São uma antiga ordem de druidas que um vez foram guardiões destas árvores.

keys: They built a castle into a small peninsula, all the way across the beach on west side of the Tulimshar Valley, past the storm.
en: They built a castle into a small peninsula, all the way across the beach on west side of the Tulimshar Valley, past the storm.
pt_BR: Construíram um castelo numa pequena península, do outro lado da praia, a oeste do Vale de Tulimshar, depois da tempestade.

keys: Just head south past the city walls and then west.
en: Just head south past the city walls and then west.
pt_BR: É só descer para o sul, passando as muralhas, e depois seguir para oeste.

keys: Find them and show them the Kano. Explain what you saw.
en: Find them and show them the Kano. Explain what you saw.
pt_BR: Encontre-os e mostre o Kano a eles. Explique o que você viu.

keys: Avoid telling anyone else about this for now. This is a very powerful item. Something that will surely attract the wrong attention.
en: Avoid telling anyone else about this for now. This is a very powerful item. Something that will surely attract the wrong attention.
pt_BR: Evite contar isso a mais alguém por enquanto. É um item muito poderoso. Algo que certamente atrairá a atenção errada.

keys: Before you go, take this.
en: Before you go, take this.
pt_BR: Antes de ir, pegue isto.

keys: It is a Zielite Amulet. The stone at its centre is a fragment of pure Zielite, the same mineral this Menhir is made of.
en: It is a Zielite Amulet. The stone at its centre is a fragment of pure Zielite, the same mineral this Menhir is made of.
pt_BR: É um Zielite Amulet. A pedra em seu centro é um fragmento de Zielite pura, o mesmo mineral deste Menhir.

keys: When worn, it allows you to channel Mana, and to connect with Soul Menhirs.
en: When worn, it allows you to channel Mana, and to connect with Soul Menhirs.
pt_BR: Quando usado, permite canalizar Mana e se conectar aos Soul Menhirs.

keys: When you touch a Soul Menhir while wearing a Zielite Amulet, the stone resonates with the Menhir's Zielite.
en: When you touch a Soul Menhir while wearing a Zielite Amulet, the stone resonates with the Menhir's Zielite.
pt_BR: Quando você toca um Soul Menhir usando um Zielite Amulet, a pedra ressoa com a Zielite do Menhir.

keys: This creates a bond between your soul and the Menhir. Should something happen to you, the Menhir acts as an anchor.
en: This creates a bond between your soul and the Menhir. Should something happen to you, the Menhir acts as an anchor.
pt_BR: Isso cria um vínculo entre sua alma e o Menhir. Caso algo aconteça com você, o Menhir age como âncora.

keys: Your soul returns here instead of being lost.
en: Your soul returns here instead of being lost.
pt_BR: Sua alma retorna aqui em vez de se perder.

keys: It is how we Kahwe have always protected those under our care. I should have given you one sooner.
en: It is how we Kahwe have always protected those under our care. I should have given you one sooner.
pt_BR: É assim que nós, Kahwe, sempre protegemos aqueles sob nossos cuidados. Eu deveria ter te dado um antes.

keys: Good. You are connected now.
en: Good. You are connected now.
pt_BR: Bom. Agora você está conectado.

keys: If you ever find another Soul Menhir, touch it. You will become attuned to the last on you have touched.
en: If you ever find another Soul Menhir, touch it. You will become attuned to the last on you have touched.
pt_BR: Se você encontrar outro Soul Menhir, toque nele. Você ficará sintonizado ao último que tocou.

keys: Now, you should make your way to the Manayir. We cannot wait around with a Kano in our hands.
en: Now, you should make your way to the Manayir. We cannot wait around with a Kano in our hands.
pt_BR: Agora, siga para Manayir. Não podemos ficar parados com um Kano em mãos.

keys: Have you found the Manayir yet?
en: Have you found the Manayir yet?
pt_BR: Já encontrou os Manayir?

keys: You should head south, then west. Their tower is past the sandstorm, on a quiet peninsula. Ask around in that area, someone should be able to point you in the right direction.
en: You should head south, then west. Their tower is past the sandstorm, on a quiet peninsula. Ask around in that area, someone should be able to point you in the right direction.
pt_BR: Você deveria descer para o sul e depois oeste. A torre deles fica além da tempestade de areia, numa península tranquila. Pergunte por lá; alguém deve saber te indicar o caminho.

keys: Hold it right there.
en: Hold it right there.
pt_BR: Pare aí mesmo.

keys: Councillor Bones' orders. Nobody walks these corridors without clearance.
en: Councillor Bones' orders. Nobody walks these corridors without clearance.
pt_BR: Ordens do Conselheiro Bones. Ninguém passa destes corredores sem autorização.

keys: I don't care why you're here. Turn around.
en: I don't care why you're here. Turn around.
pt_BR: Não me importo com o motivo de você estar aqui. Dê meia-volta.

keys: Ah, welcome! I'm afraid the shelves are empty at the moment.
en: Ah, welcome! I'm afraid the shelves are empty at the moment.
pt_BR: Ah, seja bem-vindo! Receio que as prateleiras estejam vazias no momento.

keys: Tulimshar doesn't have any good farmland. As you can see around you, we're in a desert. Nothing grows out here but cactus.
en: Tulimshar doesn't have any good farmland. As you can see around you, we're in a desert. Nothing grows out here but cactus.
pt_BR: Tulimshar não tem boas terras agrícolas. Como pode ver ao redor, estamos num deserto. Nada cresce aqui além de cactus.

keys: I have my flour shipped in from Artis to keep my bakery running. My Sandstorm Bread has fed this city for many years.
en: I have my flour shipped in from Artis to keep my bakery running. My Sandstorm Bread has fed this city for many years.
pt_BR: Minha farinha vem de Artis para manter a padaria funcionando. Meu Sandstorm Bread alimenta esta cidade há muitos anos.

keys: A delivery arrived at the docks this morning, but walking back and forth in this heat is exhausting.
en: A delivery arrived at the docks this morning, but walking back and forth in this heat is exhausting.
pt_BR: Uma entrega chegou aos cais esta manhã, mas ficar indo e voltando neste calor é exaustivo.

keys: If I go myself, I'll be too tired to bake anything today.
en: If I go myself, I'll be too tired to bake anything today.
pt_BR: Se eu for pessoalmente, ficarei cansado demais para assar qualquer coisa hoje.

keys: The barrels from the Artis bakery are marked by a blue wax seal. Could you bring me the flour bags that are inside?
en: The barrels from the Artis bakery are marked by a blue wax seal. Could you bring me the flour bags that are inside?
pt_BR: Os barris da padaria de Artis são marcados por um selo de cera azul. Você poderia me trazer os sacos de farinha que estão dentro?

keys: Any luck at the docks? Look for barrels marked with a blue seal.
en: Any luck at the docks? Look for barrels marked with a blue seal.
pt_BR: Algum sorte nos cais? Procure por barris marcados com um selo azul.

keys: I'll have the ovens hot and ready.
en: I'll have the ovens hot and ready.
pt_BR: Deixarei os fornos quentes e prontos.

keys: Even in this heat, a warm loaf of bread is hard to pass on.
en: Even in this heat, a warm loaf of bread is hard to pass on.
pt_BR: Mesmo neste calor, um pão quentinho é difícil de recusar.

keys: My signature recipe! Flour from Artis, cactus juice instead of regular water and a pinch of desert salt.
en: My signature recipe! Flour from Artis, cactus juice instead of regular water and a pinch of desert salt.
pt_BR: Minha receita exclusiva! Farinha de Artis, suco de cactus no lugar da água comum e uma pitada de sal do deserto.

keys: The crust holds through sandstorms and still tastes fresh the next morning. That's how it earned the name.
en: The crust holds through sandstorms and still tastes fresh the next morning. That's how it earned the name.
pt_BR: A casca resiste às tempestades de areia e ainda está fresca na manhã seguinte. Foi assim que ganhou o nome.

keys: Cactus, mostly. Hardy plants, and we make good use of them. Candy, drinks, even medicine.
en: Cactus, mostly. Hardy plants, and we make good use of them. Candy, drinks, even medicine.
pt_BR: Cactus, principalmente. Plantas resistentes, e tiramos bom proveito delas. Doces, bebidas, até remédios.

keys: But grain? Tonori has never been the place to grow grain. Without the trade ships, this city would go hungry.
en: But grain? Tonori has never been the place to grow grain. Without the trade ships, this city would go hungry.
pt_BR: Mas grãos? Tonori nunca foi lugar de plantar grãos. Sem os navios de comércio, esta cidade passaria fome.

keys: Great port city across the ocean, on the Aurora coast. Rich farmland, skilled artisans.
en: Great port city across the ocean, on the Aurora coast. Rich farmland, skilled artisans.
pt_BR: Grande cidade portuária do outro lado do oceano, na costa de Aurora. Terras férteis, artesãos habilidosos.

keys: My sister lives there. She bakes the most delicious cookies! The flour I get is shipped from her bakery.
en: My sister lives there. She bakes the most delicious cookies! The flour I get is shipped from her bakery.
pt_BR: Minha irmã mora lá. Ela assa os biscoitos mais deliciosos! A farinha que uso vem da padaria dela.

keys: The merchant ships from Artis keep half of Tulimshar's market stocked. Without them, we'd have little more than cactus to eat.
en: The merchant ships from Artis keep half of Tulimshar's market stocked. Without them, we'd have little more than cactus to eat.
pt_BR: Os navios mercantes de Artis mantêm metade do mercado de Tulimshar abastecido. Sem eles, teríamos pouco mais que cactus para comer.

keys: Trading. It has always been Tulimshar's greatest skill. How else does a city like this thrive in a windy desert valley?
en: Trading. It has always been Tulimshar's greatest skill. How else does a city like this thrive in a windy desert valley?
pt_BR: Comércio. Sempre foi a maior habilidade de Tulimshar. Como mais uma cidade como esta prosperaria num vale desértico e ventoso?

keys: We sit at the crossroads of three continents. Everything passes through Tulimshar's port sooner or later.
en: We sit at the crossroads of three continents. Everything passes through Tulimshar's port sooner or later.
pt_BR: Estamos na encruzilhada de três continentes. Tudo passa pelo porto de Tulimshar, mais cedo ou mais tarde.

keys: It also keeps us fed, but for a business like mine it means always waiting on the next ship to come in.
en: It also keeps us fed, but for a business like mine it means always waiting on the next ship to come in.
pt_BR: Ela também nos alimenta, mas para um negócio como o meu significa esperar sempre pelo próximo navio.

keys: Stop by anytime. There's always a fresh loaf waiting.
en: Stop by anytime. There's always a fresh loaf waiting.
pt_BR: Passe quando quiser. Sempre tem um pão quentinho esperando.

keys: Much appreciated, friend.
en: Much appreciated, friend.
pt_BR: Muito agradecido, amigo.

keys: Look for the deep blue seal. You can't miss it.
en: Look for the deep blue seal. You can't miss it.
pt_BR: Procure o selo azul-escuro. Impossível não ver.

keys: No trouble. The ovens will wait, then.
en: No trouble. The ovens will wait, then.
pt_BR: Sem problema. Os fornos esperam, então.

keys: Have you checked the docks? The flour sacks should be inside the barrel with the blue seal.
en: Have you checked the docks? The flour sacks should be inside the barrel with the blue seal.
pt_BR: Já conferiu os cais? Os sacos de farinha devem estar dentro do barril com o selo azul.

keys: You found them! But it looks like your bag is too full for me to give you anything in return.
en: You found them! But it looks like your bag is too full for me to give you anything in return.
pt_BR: Você os encontrou! Mas parece que sua bolsa está cheia demais para eu te dar algo em troca.

keys: Free up some space and come back.
en: Free up some space and come back.
pt_BR: Libere um pouco de espaço e volte.

keys: You found them! Wonderful.
en: You found them! Wonderful.
pt_BR: Você os encontrou! Maravilhoso.

keys: With this flour, Tulimshar will have fresh Sandstorm Bread by sundown.
en: With this flour, Tulimshar will have fresh Sandstorm Bread by sundown.
pt_BR: Com esta farinha, Tulimshar terá Sandstorm Bread fresco antes do anoitecer.

keys: Here, take some of my best. Croissants and cactus candy. One is a family recipe and the other one is a specialty of Tulimshar!
en: Here, take some of my best. Croissants and cactus candy. One is a family recipe and the other one is a specialty of Tulimshar!
pt_BR: Pegue um pouco do que tenho de melhor. Croissants e doce de cactus. Um é receita de família e o outro é especialidade de Tulimshar!

keys: What do you need help with?
en: What do you need help with?
pt_BR: Em que você precisa de ajuda?

keys: Head north. You'll get there.
en: Head north. You'll get there.
pt_BR: Siga para o norte. Você chega lá.

keys: The port is where most goods come in from outside Tonori.
en: The port is where most goods come in from outside Tonori.
pt_BR: O porto é por onde entra a maioria das mercadorias de fora de Tonori.

keys: It's usually busy, I wouldn't mess with sailors while they work if I were you.
en: It's usually busy, I wouldn't mess with sailors while they work if I were you.
pt_BR: Costuma estar movimentado; eu não mexeria com marinheiros trabalhando se fosse você.

keys: Personally, I'd rather stay near the castle than deal with that crowd.
en: Personally, I'd rather stay near the castle than deal with that crowd.
pt_BR: Pessoalmente, prefiro ficar perto do castelo a lidar com aquela multidão.

keys: Long stretch of beach to the east. If you like sand, you'll love it. Not everyone likes sand though...
en: Long stretch of beach to the east. If you like sand, you'll love it. Not everyone likes sand though...
pt_BR: Praia longa para o leste. Se você gosta de areia, vai adorar. Mas nem todo mundo gosta...

keys: Northeast of here there's a large lighthouse. It overlooks the whole ocean from up there.
en: Northeast of here there's a large lighthouse. It overlooks the whole ocean from up there.
pt_BR: Nordeste daqui há um grande farol. De lá de cima ele avista o oceano inteiro.

keys: Hard to miss, useful landmark.
en: Hard to miss, useful landmark.
pt_BR: Difícil não ver; marco útil.

keys: If you keep going east you will find Manayir Island, just further along the beach.
en: If you keep going east you will find Manayir Island, just further along the beach.
pt_BR: Se continuar para o leste, encontrará a Ilha de Manayir, mais adiante pela praia.

keys: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe? I drew the board myself!
en: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe? I drew the board myself!
pt_BR: Quer jogar jogo da velha? Fui eu que desenhei o tabuleiro!

keys: I can't draw round circles, so I just draw squares instead. But Andi keeps making fun of me.
en: I can't draw round circles, so I just draw squares instead. But Andi keeps making fun of me.
pt_BR: Não consigo desenhar círculos redondos, então desenho quadrados. Mas a Andi não para de zoar.

keys: Wanna play tic-tac-toe?
en: Wanna play tic-tac-toe?
pt_BR: Quer jogar jogo da velha?

keys: I saw a pirate crew playing tic-tac-toe against some guards the other day.
en: I saw a pirate crew playing tic-tac-toe against some guards the other day.
pt_BR: Vi uma tripulação de piratas jogando jogo da velha contra uns guardas esses dias.

keys: Wanna play?
en: Wanna play?
pt_BR: Quer jogar?

keys: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe?
en: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe?
pt_BR: Quer jogar jogo da velha?

keys: Hey, someone's already waiting to play! You should go against them!
en: Hey, someone's already waiting to play! You should go against them!
pt_BR: Ei, já tem alguém esperando para jogar! Você deveria enfrentar essa pessoa!

keys: Nobody showed up yet... Wanna keep waiting?
en: Nobody showed up yet... Wanna keep waiting?
pt_BR: Ninguém apareceu ainda... Quer continuar esperando?

keys: Hey, no cheating! Go play your game!
en: Hey, no cheating! Go play your game!
pt_BR: Ei, sem trapaça! Vá jogar seu jogo!

keys: Shhh, they're playing! You can watch though.
en: Shhh, they're playing! You can watch though.
pt_BR: Shhh, estão jogando! Mas você pode assistir.

keys: So you pick a square and put your mark on it, then the other person goes.
en: So you pick a square and put your mark on it, then the other person goes.
pt_BR: Então você escolhe um quadrado e marca, e o outro joga.

keys: If you get three in a row you win! Like across, up and down, or the diagonal ones.
en: If you get three in a row you win! Like across, up and down, or the diagonal ones.
pt_BR: Se fizer três em linha, você vence! Na horizontal, vertical ou nas diagonais.

keys: And if the whole board fills up and nobody won, it's a tie. Those are boring though.
en: And if the whole board fills up and nobody won, it's a tie. Those are boring though.
pt_BR: E se o tabuleiro encher e ninguém vencer, é empate. Mas esses são chatos.

keys: You're X! Pick a square, go go go!
en: You're X! Pick a square, go go go!
pt_BR: Você é o X! Escolha um quadrado, vamos, vamos!

keys: Hang on, someone's already playing! Wait your turn.
en: Hang on, someone's already playing! Wait your turn.
pt_BR: Espere aí, já tem alguém jogando! Aguarde sua vez.

keys: Now we wait for someone to show up...
en: Now we wait for someone to show up...
pt_BR: Agora esperamos alguém aparecer...

keys: Yay, you're both here! Have fun!
en: Yay, you're both here! Have fun!
pt_BR: Oba, vocês dois aqui! Divirtam-se!

keys: Nuh-uh, the board's taken right now!
en: Nuh-uh, the board's taken right now!
pt_BR: Opa, o tabuleiro está ocupado agora!

keys: Halt! You must not proceed further.
en: Halt! You must not proceed further.
pt_BR: Alto! Você não pode avançar mais.

keys: Beyond this point lies the throne room of the Red Queen herself. Turn back now.
en: Beyond this point lies the throne room of the Red Queen herself. Turn back now.
pt_BR: Adiante fica a sala do trono da própria Rainha Vermelha. Volte agora.

keys: Don't bother me.
en: Don't bother me.
pt_BR: Não me incomode.

keys: Essence is earned when XP overflows at the level cap.
en: Essence is earned when XP overflows at the level cap.
pt_BR: A essência é ganha quando o XP transborda no nível máximo.

pt_BR: Bem-vindo ao Shambleta!\n\nEste é um RPG idle — seu personagem luta sozinho. Vamos fazer um tour rápido.

keys: Your character is shown here.\n\nYou can customize attributes, equipment, and skills. Press F2 to open the character window.
en: Your character is shown here.\n\nYou can customize attributes, equipment, and skills. Press F2 to open the character window.
pt_BR: Seu personagem é mostrado aqui.\n\nVocê pode customizar atributos, equipamento e habilidades. Pressione F2 para abrir a janela do personagem.

keys: Pick a farm zone to start earning gold and XP automatically.\n\nOpen the zone map with /zones or F6.
en: Pick a farm zone to start earning gold and XP automatically.\n\nOpen the zone map with /zones or F6.
pt_BR: Escolha uma zona de farm para começar a ganhar ouro e XP automaticamente.\n\nAbra o mapa de zonas com /zones ou F6.

keys: When you come back, your AFK earnings are ready to claim.\n\nCheck the AFK report window for offline progress.
en: When you come back, your AFK earnings are ready to claim.\n\nCheck the AFK report window for offline progress.
pt_BR: Quando você voltar, seus ganhos AFK estarão prontos para coletar.\n\nVerifique a janela de relatório AFK para ver o progresso offline.

keys: Spend your gems in the shop!\n\nBuy chests, VIP status, and more.
en: Spend your gems in the shop!\n\nBuy chests, VIP status, and more.
pt_BR: Gaste suas gems na loja!\n\nCompre baús, status VIP e mais.

keys: You're all set!\n\nYour character will now farm automatically. Come back later to collect your rewards.
